title.zh: 卷348 列傳一百三十五 赛衝阿 纶布春 札克塔尔 马瑜 薛大烈等
title.en: Volume 348 Biographies 135: Sai Chong A, Lun Bu Chun, Zha Ke Ta Er, Ma Yu, Xue Daliedeng
title.raw: 卷348 列傳一百三十五 赛衝阿 纶布春 札克塔尔 马瑜 薛大烈等

sentences.zh: 列傳一百三十五

translations.literal: Biographies 135
translations.idiomatic: Biographies 135

sentences.zh: 賽衝阿溫春色爾滾蘇爾慎阿哈保綸布春格布舍

translations.literal: Sai Chong'a, Wenchun, Se'ergun, Su'ershen, Ahabao, Lunbuchun, Geburshe
translations.idiomatic: Sai Chong'a, Wenchun, Se'ergun, Su'ershen, Ahabao, Lunbuchun, and Geburshe

sentences.zh: 札克塔爾桑吉斯塔爾馬瑜蒲尚佐薛大烈羅聲皋薛升

translations.literal: Zhaketaer, Sangjisi, Ta'er, Mayu, Pushangzuo, Xue Dalie, Luo Shenggao, Xue Sheng
translations.idiomatic: Zhaketaer, Sangjisi, Ta'er, Mayu, Pushangzuo, Xue Dalie, Luo Shenggao, and Xue Sheng

sentences.zh: 賽衝阿，赫舍里氏，滿洲正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Sai Chong'a, of the Heseri clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Sai Chong'a, of the Heseri clan, was a Manchu bannerman of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 襲雲騎尉世職，充十五善射，授健銳營參領。

translations.literal: He inherited the hereditary office of Commandant of Cavalry, served among the Fifteen Skilled Archers, and was appointed a company commander in the Vanguard Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: He inherited the hereditary rank of Commandant of Cavalry, served as one of the Fifteen Skilled Archers, and was appointed a company commander in the Vanguard Brigade.

sentences.zh: 徵台灣力戰，賜號斐靈額巴圖魯，圖形紫光閣。

translations.literal: In the Taiwan campaign he fought fiercely, was granted the title Feiling'e Baturu, and had his portrait placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: During the Taiwan campaign he fought with distinction, received the title Feiling'e Baturu, and was honored with a portrait in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 歷吉林、三姓副都統。

translations.literal: He successively served as vice commander at Jilin and Sansing.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as vice commander at Jilin and at Sansing.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年，率吉林兵赴四川，始終隸德楞泰麾下。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiaqing, he led Jilin troops to Sichuan and remained throughout under Delengtai's command.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jiaqing he led Jilin troops into Sichuan and served under Delengtai for the entire campaign.

sentences.zh: 張漢潮等竄平利，敗之澍河口，又敗之大寧黑虎廟。

translations.literal: Zhang Hanchao and others fled into Pingli; he defeated them at the Shu River mouth and again at the Black Tiger Temple in Daning.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhang Hanchao and his band fled into Pingli, he routed them at the mouth of the Shu River and again at the Black Tiger Temple in Daning.

sentences.zh: 追齊王氏、姚之富入寧羌山中，要之羅村壩，以勁騎橫衝賊陣，往來擊射，大破之。

translations.literal: Pursuing Qi the Wang and Yao Zhifu into the mountains of Ningqiang, he intercepted them at Luocun Dam, sent crack cavalry charging across the rebel formation, and struck back and forth with bow and musket until the enemy was shattered.
translations.idiomatic: He pursued Qi the Wang and Yao Zhifu into the Ningqiang mountains, cut them off at Luocun Dam, and with elite cavalry charging through the rebel lines and wheeling to fire again and again, won a crushing victory.

sentences.zh: 三年春，破高均德於洋縣金水鋪，躡追至安子溝。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year, he defeated Gao Junde at Jinshui Post in Yang County and pursued him to Anzigou.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the third year he defeated Gao Junde at Jinshui Post in Yang County and chased him as far as Anzigou.

sentences.zh: 賊夜突營，偕總兵達音泰躍壘而出，斬賊千餘。

translations.literal: The rebels made a night assault on the camp; together with Brigadier Dayintai he leaped over the ramparts to meet them and killed more than a thousand rebels.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels stormed the camp by night, he and Brigadier Dayintai sprang over the walls to counterattack and cut down more than a thousand of the enemy.

sentences.zh: 齊、姚二賊復與均德合擾安康。

translations.literal: The two rebels Qi and Yao joined Gao Junde again to harass Ankang.
translations.idiomatic: Qi and Yao joined forces with Junde once more and raided Ankang.

sentences.zh: 師次判官嶺，賊隱深林，遣數百人誘戰，賽衝阿鼓勇先入，敗之。

translations.literal: When the army halted at Panguan Ridge, the rebels lay hidden in deep forest and sent several hundred men to lure battle; Sai Chong'a roused his courage and led the charge, defeating them.
translations.idiomatic: The army camped at Panguan Ridge, where rebels concealed in the forest sent a few hundred men as bait; Sai Chong'a took the lead in a spirited assault and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 賊走山陽，截擊於壩店，遂與明亮、德楞泰三路進逼，大破之於鄖西三岔河，齊、姚二賊投崖死。

translations.literal: The rebels fled toward Shanyang; he intercepted them at Badian, then with Mingliang and Delengtai advanced in three columns, routing them at Sancha River in western Yun, where Qi and Yao threw themselves from the cliffs to their deaths.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled toward Shanyang, but he cut them off at Badian; then he, Mingliang, and Delengtai pressed in from three directions and shattered them at Sancha River in western Yun, where Qi and Yao leaped from the cliffs to their deaths.

sentences.zh: 敘功，被珍賚。

translations.literal: His merit was recorded and he received imperial gifts.
translations.idiomatic: His achievements were entered on the rolls and he received special rewards from the throne.

sentences.zh: 四月，分剿均德於華州，連敗之洋縣茅坪、關西溝。

translations.literal: In the fourth month he joined in hunting Gao Junde at Huazhou and repeatedly defeated him at Maoping in Yang County and at Guanxi Gully.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he took part in the pursuit of Junde at Huazhou, defeating him in succession at Maoping in Yang County and at Guanxi Gully.

sentences.zh: 均德合諸賊奔渠縣大神山，會諸軍克之。

translations.literal: Junde gathered the other rebel bands and fled to Dashen Mountain in Qu County, where the combined armies took the position.
translations.idiomatic: Junde rallied the other rebel chiefs and fled to Dashen Mountain in Qu County, where the allied forces finally captured him.

sentences.zh: 自秋徂冬，迭克箕山、大鵬寨、青觀山，遂擒羅其清、冉文儔，功皆最。

translations.literal: From autumn through winter he took in succession Jishan, Dapeng Stockade, and Qingguan Mountain, then captured Luo Qiqing and Ran Wenfu, ranking foremost in merit throughout.
translations.idiomatic: From autumn through winter he captured Jishan, Dapeng Stockade, and Qingguan Mountain in turn, then took Luo Qiqing and Ran Wenfu prisoner; in each action his merit ranked first.

sentences.zh: 四年夏，敗徐天德於開縣旗桿山，敗張天倫於太平修溪壩。

translations.literal: In the summer of the fourth year he defeated Xu Tiande at Qigan Mountain in Kai County and Zhang Tianlun at Xiuxi Dam in Taiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the fourth year he routed Xu Tiande at Qigan Mountain in Kai County and Zhang Tianlun at Xiuxi Dam in Taiping.

sentences.zh: 秋，龔文玉踞夔州八石坪。

translations.literal: In autumn Gong Wenyu held Bashiping in Kuizhou.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Gong Wenyu occupied Bashiping in Kuizhou.

sentences.zh: 從德楞泰進攻，破賊寨，追敗之竹谿大禾田，擒文玉。

translations.literal: Following Delengtai in the assault, he stormed the rebel stockade, pursued and defeated them at Dahetian in Zhuxi, and captured Wenyu.
translations.idiomatic: He joined Delengtai's assault, broke the rebel stockade, pursued the enemy to Dahetian in Zhuxi, and captured Wenyu.

sentences.zh: 冬，擊高均德於大市川，遂破高家營，擒均德。

translations.literal: In winter he struck Gao Junde at Dashichuan, then broke Gaojia Camp and captured Junde.
translations.idiomatic: In winter he attacked Junde at Dashichuan, overran Gaojia Camp, and took Junde prisoner.

sentences.zh: 進兵川北，殲張金魁於通江空水河，擒符曰明等於廣元野人村。

translations.literal: Advancing into northern Sichuan, he annihilated Zhang Jinkui at Kongshui River in Tongjiang and captured Fu Yueming and others at Yeren Village in Guangyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He marched into northern Sichuan, destroyed Zhang Jinkui at Kongshui River in Tongjiang, and captured Fu Yueming and others at Yeren Village in Guangyuan.

sentences.zh: 复移軍川北，迭敗苟文明、鮮大川於貓兒梁、馬家營。

translations.literal: He again shifted his army in northern Sichuan and repeatedly defeated Gou Wenming and Xian Dachuan at Mao'erliang and Majia Camp.
translations.idiomatic: Moving once more through northern Sichuan, he defeated Gou Wenming and Xian Dachuan in succession at Mao'erliang and Majia Camp.

sentences.zh: 五年春，從德楞泰由陝回川西，擊冉天元於江油新店子，又大戰馬蹄岡，並深入遇伏，先挫後勝，天元就擒。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifth year he followed Delengtai from Shaanxi back into western Sichuan, attacked Ran Tianyuan at Xindianzi in Jiangyou, and fought a great battle at Matigang; both sides pushed deep and met ambush, suffering setback before victory, and Tianyuan was captured.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fifth year he followed Delengtai from Shaanxi back into western Sichuan, struck Ran Tianyuan at Xindianzi in Jiangyou, and fought a major battle at Matigang; both armies advanced deep, ran into ambush, and after an initial reverse won the day, and Tianyuan was taken.

sentences.zh: 詳德楞泰傳。

translations.literal: Details are given in the biography of Delengtai.
translations.idiomatic: The full account appears in Delengtai's biography.

sentences.zh: 乘勝破賊劍州李家坪、石門寨。

translations.literal: Pressing the victory, he broke the rebels at Lijia Ping and Shimen Stockade in Jianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Following up his victory, he overran the rebel positions at Lijia Ping and Shimen Stockade in Jianzhou.

sentences.zh: 俄而張子聰、雷世旺犯蓬溪，圍成谷、太和、仁和、仁義四寨。

translations.literal: Soon Zhang Zicong and Lei Shiwang invaded Pengxi and besieged the four stockades of Chenggu, Taihe, Renhe, and Renyi.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Zhang Zicong and Lei Shiwang attacked Pengxi and laid siege to the four stockades of Chenggu, Taihe, Renhe, and Renyi.

sentences.zh: 偕溫春往援，斬世旺。

translations.literal: He went to their relief with Wenchun and beheaded Shiwang.
translations.idiomatic: He marched to their relief with Wenchun and killed Shiwang.

sentences.zh: 破冉天泗、王士虎於南江長池壩，破鮮大川、苟文明於岳池新場，擢固原提督。

translations.literal: He defeated Ran Tiansi and Wang Shihu at Changchi Dam in Nanjiang and Xian Dachuan and Gou Wenming at Xinchang in Yuechi, and was promoted to provincial commander at Guyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He routed Ran Tiansi and Wang Shihu at Changchi Dam in Nanjiang and Xian Dachuan and Gou Wenming at Xinchang in Yuechi, and was promoted to provincial commander at Guyuan.

sentences.zh: 命赴陝專剿高天德，馬學禮諸賊，德楞泰素倚吉林馬隊，賽衝阿尤得眾心，士卒聞其將去，環跪乞留，累疏陳狀，請權緩急，暫留川，允之。

translations.literal: He was ordered to Shaanxi to hunt Gao Tiande, Ma Xueli, and other rebels; Delengtai had long relied on the Jilin cavalry, and Sai Chong'a above all held the soldiers' hearts—when the troops heard he was to leave, they knelt in a ring begging him to stay; memorial after memorial set forth the case, asking that authority follow urgency and that he remain temporarily in Sichuan, and this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to Shaanxi to pursue Gao Tiande, Ma Xueli, and the other rebel chiefs. Delengtai had always depended on the Jilin horse columns, and Sai Chong'a above all commanded the men's loyalty; when the troops learned he was to depart, they knelt around him pleading that he stay. Repeated memorials explained the situation and asked that he be kept in Sichuan according to the needs of the moment, and the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 秋，從德楞泰擊趙麻花、王珊於雲陽寒池壩、濫泥溝，並殲之。

translations.literal: In autumn, following Delengtai, he attacked Zhao Ma'hua and Wang Shan at Hanchi Dam and Lan'ni Gully in Yunyang and destroyed them both.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn he followed Delengtai against Zhao Ma'hua and Wang Shan at Hanchi Dam and Lan'ni Gully in Yunyang and wiped out both bands.

sentences.zh: 冬，敗楊開第、李彬、齊國謨於觀音河。

translations.literal: In winter he defeated Yang Kaidi, Li Bin, and Qi Guomo at Guanyin River.
translations.idiomatic: In winter he routed Yang Kaidi, Li Bin, and Qi Guomo at Guanyin River.

sentences.zh: 六年春，破高天升於鎮安野雞坪，殲之；

translations.literal: In the spring of the sixth year he defeated Gao Tiansheng at Yejiping in Zhen'an and annihilated him;
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the sixth year he broke Gao Tiansheng at Yejiping in Zhen'an and destroyed him;

sentences.zh: 又破唐明萬等於和岡溪，進至黃花廟，賊夜犯營，奮擊，潰走。

translations.literal: he again defeated Tang Mingwan and others at Hegang Stream, advanced to Huanghua Temple, and when rebels assaulted the camp by night he fought fiercely and put them to rout.
translations.idiomatic: then he defeated Tang Mingwan and others at Hegang Stream and advanced to Huanghua Temple, where a night attack on the camp was beaten back with a fierce countercharge that sent the rebels fleeing.

sentences.zh: 夏，從德楞泰擊徐天德、樊人傑等於白河黃石坡，擒陳朝觀，偕溫春破天德於寧陝兩河口，蹙之於紫陽仁和、新灘，天德赴水死，授西安將軍。

translations.literal: In summer, following Delengtai, he attacked Xu Tiande, Fan Renjie, and others at Huangshipo on the Bai River, captured Chen Chaoguan, and with Wenchun broke Tiande at Lianghekou in Ningshan, drove him to Renhe and Xintan in Ziyang, where Tiande drowned himself; he was appointed general at Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: In summer he followed Delengtai against Xu Tiande, Fan Renjie, and others at Huangshipo on the Bai River, captured Chen Chaoguan, and with Wenchun shattered Tiande at Lianghekou in Ningshan and cornered him at Renhe and Xintan in Ziyang, where Tiande drowned himself; Sai Chong'a was appointed general at Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 諜報龍紹週由川入楚，率勁騎躡擊，先俘其妻子，复殲其兄紹華、弟紹海；

translations.literal: Intelligence reported that Long Shaozhou had entered Huguang from Sichuan; he led crack cavalry in pursuit, first capturing his wife and children, then destroying his elder brother Shaohua and younger brother Shaohai;
translations.idiomatic: Scouts reported that Long Shaozhou had crossed from Sichuan into Huguang; he led elite cavalry in pursuit, first taking Shaozhou's wife and children prisoner, then wiping out his elder brother Shaohua and younger brother Shaohai;

sentences.zh: 至平利岳家坪，冒雨雪縱兵衝踏，陣斬紹週，並蕭四餘匪盡殲之，予騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: at Yuejiaping in Pingli he braved rain and snow to charge the enemy ranks, killed Shaozhou in battle, and annihilated Xiao Si and the remaining bandits, and was granted the hereditary office of Cavalry Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: at Yuejiaping in Pingli he charged through rain and snow, killed Shaozhou on the field, and destroyed Xiao Si and the rest of the band; he was granted the hereditary rank of Cavalry Commandant.

sentences.zh: 冬，迭破劉朝選於東鄉土黃壩，奉節、大寧邊境。

translations.literal: In winter he repeatedly defeated Liu Chaoxuan at Tuhuang Dam in Dongxiang and along the borders of Fengjie and Daning.
translations.idiomatic: In winter he defeated Liu Chaoxuan again and again at Tuhuang Dam in Dongxiang and along the Fengjie and Daning frontier.

sentences.zh: 七年春，又大破之潘家槽，擒斬殆盡，朝選僅以千餘人逸；

translations.literal: In the spring of the seventh year he again routed him at Panjiacao, killing and capturing nearly all; Chaoxuan escaped with only a little more than a thousand men;
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the seventh year he smashed Liu again at Panjiacao, killing or capturing nearly his entire force; Chaoxuan escaped with barely a thousand men;

sentences.zh: 敗宋國品於梁山柏林槽，擒席尚文於東鄉袁家壩；

translations.literal: he defeated Song Guopin at Bolincao in Liangshan and captured Xi Shangwen at Yuanjiaba in Dongxiang;
translations.idiomatic: he defeated Song Guopin at Bolincao in Liangshan and took Xi Shangwen at Yuanjiaba in Dongxiang;

sentences.zh: 與勒保部將夾擊陳自得於大竹、鄰水，大破之：調寧夏將軍。

translations.literal: and with a subordinate of Lebao struck Chen Zide from both sides at Dazhu and Linshui, routing him decisively; he was transferred to general at Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: and with one of Lebao's officers caught Chen Zide in a pincer at Dazhu and Linshui and broke him completely; he was transferred to the post of Ningxia general.

sentences.zh: 夏，從德楞泰赴楚剿樊人傑，人傑與蒲天寶相犄角，迭敗人傑於雞公山、譚家廟，又克天寶於大埡口。

translations.literal: In summer he followed Delengtai into Huguang to suppress Fan Renjie; Renjie and Pu Tianbao supported each other; he repeatedly defeated Renjie at Jigong Mountain and Tanjia Temple and also overcame Tianbao at Dayakou.
translations.idiomatic: In summer he followed Delengtai into Huguang to hunt Fan Renjie, who was coordinating with Pu Tianbao; he defeated Renjie in succession at Jigong Mountain and Tanjia Temple and also overcame Tianbao at Dayakou.

sentences.zh: 人傑竄平口河腦，自黃茅埡進逼之，無去路，人傑投河死。

translations.literal: Renjie fled to Pingkouhenao; advancing from Huangmaoya to press him, he left no escape, and Renjie threw himself into the river and died.
translations.idiomatic: Renjie fled to Pingkouhenao; Sai Chong'a advanced from Huangmaoya and closed every escape route, and Renjie drowned himself in the river.

sentences.zh: 額勒登保檄赴陝，駐太平河，截剿川、楚竄匪。

translations.literal: Eledengbao ordered him to Shaanxi to garrison at Taiping River and intercept rebels fleeing between Sichuan and Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: Eledengbao ordered him to Shaanxi to hold Taiping River and cut off rebels shuttling between Sichuan and Huguang.

sentences.zh: 是冬，大功戡定，詔論諸將戰績，以賽衝阿與楊遇春居最，予輕車都尉世職。

translations.literal: That winter the great pacification was complete; an edict reviewed the generals' battle records and ranked Sai Chong'a with Yang Yuchun foremost, granting the hereditary office of Commandant of Light Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the great campaign was concluded; an edict reviewed the commanders' records and placed Sai Chong'a with Yang Yuchun at the head of them all, granting him the hereditary rank of Commandant of Light Chariots.

sentences.zh: 九年，調西安將軍，命偕德楞泰檢捕南山殘匪，隨同奏事。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was transferred to general at Xi'an and ordered to join Delengtai in hunting down remnant bandits in the southern mountains, reporting jointly on affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was made Xi'an general and ordered to join Delengtai in rooting out remnant rebels in the southern mountains, the two reporting to the throne together.

sentences.zh: 尋以遲延降騎都尉。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was demoted to Cavalry Commandant for delay.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon demoted to Cavalry Commandant for dilatoriness in the pursuit.

sentences.zh: 賊平，還舊職，調廣州將軍。

translations.literal: When the rebels were pacified he was restored to his former rank and transferred to general at Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: After the rebels were pacified his former rank was restored and he was transferred to Guangzhou as general.

sentences.zh: 十一年春，海盜蔡牽犯台灣，命副德楞泰往討，會牽為李長庚擊走，乃專任賽衝阿為欽差大臣，提督以下受節制。

translations.literal: In the spring of the eleventh year the pirate Cai Qian invaded Taiwan; he was ordered to assist Delengtai in the expedition, but as Qian had already been driven off by Li Changgeng, Sai Chong'a alone was made imperial commissioner, with provincial commanders and below under his authority.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the eleventh year the pirate Cai Qian raided Taiwan; he was first ordered to assist Delengtai, but after Qian had been driven off by Li Changgeng, Sai Chong'a alone was appointed imperial commissioner with authority over the provincial commanders and all ranks below.

sentences.zh: 尋責專辦陸路，至則鳳山已復，南北兩路僅餘零匪，請停調兩粵、福州駐防兵，水師責成李長庚，陸路責成許文謨。

translations.literal: Soon he was charged solely with land operations; on arrival Fengshan had already been recovered and only scattered bandits remained on the northern and southern routes; he requested that garrison troops from the two Guang provinces and Fuzhou cease to be transferred, assigning the naval forces to Li Changgeng and the land forces to Xu Wenmo.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon assigned land operations only; when he arrived Fengshan had already been retaken and only scattered rebels remained along the northern and southern routes. He asked that no more garrison troops be shifted from the two Guang provinces and Fuzhou, leaving the navy to Li Changgeng and the land campaign to Xu Wenmo.

sentences.zh: 詔嘉其曉事，調福州將軍。

translations.literal: An edict praised his good sense and transferred him to general at Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The throne praised his sound judgment and transferred him to Fuzhou as general.

sentences.zh: 秋，牽復入鹿耳門，檄鎮將擊沉賊艦十一，獲船十，擒賊目林略等。

translations.literal: In autumn Qian again entered Luerhmen; he ordered the territorial commanders to sink eleven rebel vessels, capture ten ships, and take the rebel chiefs Lin Lue and others.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Qian re-entered Luerhmen; he ordered the frontier commanders to sink eleven rebel ships, seize ten more, and capture the rebel leaders Lin Lue and others.

sentences.zh: 十二年，蔡牽、硃濆皆窮蹙，乃赴本官。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year Cai Qian and Zhu Fen were both cornered, and he returned to his regular post.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, with Cai Qian and Zhu Fen both at bay, he returned to his regular command.

sentences.zh: 十四年，調西安，尋調吉林。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was transferred to Xi'an and soon afterward to Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was transferred to Xi'an and soon after to Jilin.

sentences.zh: 十六年，入覲，途見岫岩、復州流民，奏下副都統松箖安撫。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he came to court for audience; on the road he saw displaced people at Xiuyan and Fuzhou and memorialized that Vice Commander Song Lin should pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he came to court; on the journey he saw refugees at Xiuyan and Fuzhou and memorialized that Vice Commander Song Lin should be ordered to provide relief.

sentences.zh: 會鬆箖疏請驅逐流民出境，詔斥其誤，命如賽衝阿所議行。

translations.literal: At the same time Song Lin memorialized asking to drive the refugees beyond the border; an edict rebuked his error and ordered that Sai Chong'a's proposal be followed.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Song Lin had memorialized asking to expel the refugees across the border; the throne rebuked his mistake and ordered that Sai Chong'a's plan be carried out.

sentences.zh: 十八年，調成都將軍。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was transferred to general at Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he was made Chengdu general.

sentences.zh: 二十年，剿陝西南山匪，連破之木竹壩、太陽灘，進薄漢北，凡兩月肅清，封二等男爵，賜雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he suppressed bandits in the southern mountains of Shaanxi, repeatedly defeating them at Muzhuba and Taiyangtan, pressing close to northern Han, and within two months restoring order; he was enfeoffed as a second-class baron and granted the double-eyed peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he campaigned against bandits in southern Shaanxi, defeating them in succession at Muzhuba and Taiyangtan and pressing toward northern Han; within two months the region was cleared, and he was enfeoffed as a second-class baron and given the double-eyed peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，廓爾喀與披楞構兵，互請援，命賽衝阿行邊防之而已。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year Gurkha and Bhutan went to war and each asked for aid; Sai Chong'a was ordered merely to inspect the frontier defenses.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year Nepal and Bhutan went to war, each asking China for help; Sai Chong'a was ordered only to inspect the frontier defenses.

sentences.zh: 誤會上旨，馳檄諭詰，復請越境脅以兵威，詔斥貪功構釁，奪雙眼花翎，降二品頂戴。

translations.literal: Misunderstanding the imperial intent, he sent urgent dispatches of reproof and again asked to cross the border and intimidate with military force; an edict rebuked his greed for merit and provocation of conflict, stripped the double-eyed peacock feather, and reduced him to a second-grade court hat.
translations.idiomatic: Misreading the throne's intent, he fired off urgent dispatches of rebuke and again asked to cross the border and threaten war; an edict condemned his hunger for glory and willingness to provoke conflict, stripped him of the double-eyed peacock feather, and reduced his court hat to the second grade.

sentences.zh: 尋以兩國言和，復之。

translations.literal: Soon, because the two countries made peace, these honors were restored.
translations.idiomatic: When the two states made peace shortly afterward, his honors were restored.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，召為正白旗漢軍都統、御前大臣、領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he was summoned as commander of the Chinese Plain White Banner, imperial attendant minister, and leading grand minister of the Imperial Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he was recalled to serve as commander of the Chinese Plain White Banner, imperial attendant minister, and leading grand minister of the Imperial Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 尋授盛京將軍。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed general at Shengjing.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed Shengjing general.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，復召為理籓院尚書，兼御前諸職如故。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he was again summoned as minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs, retaining his former imperial attendant posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year he was recalled again as minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs while keeping his court attendant posts.

sentences.zh: 宣宗即位，加太子少保，賜紫韁，管理咸安宮蒙古、唐古忒，托忒諸學。

translations.literal: When the Xuanzong Emperor acceded, he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, granted a purple bridle, and put in charge of Mongolian, Tangut, and Oirat studies at the Xian'an Palace.
translations.idiomatic: When the Daoguang Emperor came to the throne, he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, granted a purple bridle, and placed in charge of Mongolian, Tangut, and Oirat instruction at the Xian'an Palace.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，出為西安將軍。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daoguang he went out as general at Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Daoguang he was posted again as Xi'an general.

sentences.zh: 三年，入祝萬壽，賜宴玉瀾堂，列十五老臣，繪像，御製詩褒之。

translations.literal: In the third year he entered court to offer birthday congratulations, was feasted at the Yulan Hall, ranked among the fifteen venerable ministers, had his portrait painted, and received an imperial poem in praise.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he came to court for the imperial birthday, was entertained at the Yulan Hall among the fifteen elder statesmen, had his portrait painted, and received an imperial poem in his honor.

sentences.zh: 四年，召授內大臣、鑲藍旗蒙古都統，充總諳達。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was summoned as grand minister and commander of the Mongolian Bordered Blue Banner, and served as chief interpreter.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was recalled as grand minister and commander of the Mongolian Bordered Blue Banner and appointed chief interpreter.

sentences.zh: 六年，以疾乞休。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, on grounds of illness, he asked to retire.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he asked to retire on account of illness.

sentences.zh: 尋卒，贈太子太師，命皇子賜奠，諡襄勤。

translations.literal: He soon died and was posthumously made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent; a prince was ordered to offer sacrifice, and he was given the posthumous name Xiangqin.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon afterward and was posthumously honored as Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent; a prince was sent to offer sacrifice, and he received the posthumous name Xiangqin.

sentences.zh: 子額圖渾，三等侍衛。

translations.literal: His son Etuhun was a third-class imperial bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: His son Etuhun served as a third-class imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 孫特克慎，襲男爵，坐事除名。

translations.literal: His grandson Tekeshen inherited the barony but was struck from the rolls for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Tekeshen inherited the barony but was stripped of his name and rank after an offense.

sentences.zh: 曾孫清福，襲官四等侍衛。

translations.literal: His great-grandson Qingfu inherited the office of fourth-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandson Qingfu inherited the post of fourth-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 溫春，默爾丹氏，滿洲正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Wenchun, of the Mo'erdan clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Wenchun, of the Mo'erdan clan, was a Manchu bannerman of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 由拜唐阿累擢三等侍衛。

translations.literal: From the rank of baitangga he was repeatedly promoted to third-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: Starting as a baitangga, he rose through repeated promotions to third-class imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 從征廓爾喀。

translations.literal: He followed the campaign against Gurkha.
translations.idiomatic: He served in the Nepal campaign.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十九年，高宗幸南苑行圍，以殺虎超擢頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year of Qianlong, when the Gaozong Emperor visited the Southern Park for the hunt, he was promoted to first-class bodyguard for killing a tiger in a single bound.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-ninth year of Qianlong, when the emperor hunted at the Southern Park, he was promoted to first-class bodyguard for killing a tiger at a single leap.

sentences.zh: 明年，從征苗疆，連克蘇麻寨、大烏草河，賜號克酬巴圖魯。

translations.literal: The next year he followed the Miao campaign, took in succession Sumazhai and Dawucao River, and was granted the title Kezhou Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he joined the Miao campaign, captured Sumazhai and Dawucao River in succession, and received the title Kezhou Baturu.

sentences.zh: 大戰尖雲山，與總兵達音泰分將左右軍，晝夜鏖鬥，遂復乾州。

translations.literal: In the great battle at Jianyun Mountain he and Brigadier Dayintai commanded the left and right wings, fighting day and night until Qianzhou was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: At the great battle of Jianyun Mountain he and Brigadier Dayintai commanded the left and right wings, fighting day and night until Qianzhou was retaken.

sentences.zh: 苗平，從德楞泰赴四川。

translations.literal: When the Miao were pacified he followed Delengtai to Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: After the Miao rebellion was suppressed he followed Delengtai into Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年，敗賊東鄉馬耳溝，又敗齊王氏、姚之富於夔州白帝城，加副都統銜，充領隊大臣，駐守竹谿、平利，賊來犯，並卻之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiaqing he defeated rebels at Ma'ergou in Dongxiang and again defeated Qi the Wang and Yao Zhifu at Baidicheng in Kuizhou; he was given the brevet rank of vice commander, served as expeditionary minister, garrisoned Zhuxi and Pingli, and repelled every rebel attack.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jiaqing he routed rebels at Ma'ergou in Dongxiang and again defeated Qi the Wang and Yao Zhifu at Baidicheng in Kuizhou; he received the brevet rank of vice commander, served as expeditionary minister, and while garrisoning Zhuxi and Pingli beat back every rebel assault.

sentences.zh: 李潮、張世虎餘黨走渡漢，率索倫騎兵蹴之於中流，殲賊千。

translations.literal: The remnant bands of Li Chao and Zhang Shihu fled across the Han; he led Solon cavalry to strike them midstream and destroyed a thousand rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Remnants of Li Chao's and Zhang Shihu's bands fled across the Han River; he led Solon cavalry to strike them in midstream and killed a thousand of the enemy.

sentences.zh: 三年，破高均德，殲齊王氏、姚之富，破羅其清、冉文儔。

translations.literal: In the third year he defeated Gao Junde, destroyed Qi the Wang and Yao Zhifu, and broke Luo Qiqing and Ran Wenfu.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he defeated Gao Junde, wiped out Qi the Wang and Yao Zhifu, and broke Luo Qiqing and Ran Wenfu.

sentences.zh: 四年，破張天倫，擒龔文玉，擒高均德。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he defeated Zhang Tianlun, captured Gong Wenyu, and captured Gao Junde.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he defeated Zhang Tianlun and captured Gong Wenyu and Gao Junde.

sentences.zh: 諸役皆與賽衝阿同為軍鋒，名績相埒。

translations.literal: In all these campaigns he served with Sai Chong'a as army vanguard, and their fame and achievements were equal.
translations.idiomatic: In all these operations he and Sai Chong'a alike led the van, and their fame and achievements matched each other.

sentences.zh: 方高家營之未破也，賊扼大市川，倚險抗拒，鼓勇先登，馬蹶，易騎而上，殺賊獨多，詔特嘉之。

translations.literal: Before Gaojia Camp was taken, the rebels held Dashichuan and resisted from strong ground; he roused his courage to lead the ascent, his horse stumbled, he changed mounts and mounted again, and killed more rebels than any other; an edict gave him special praise.
translations.idiomatic: Before Gaojia Camp fell the rebels held Dashichuan and fought from the high ground; he led the assault with great spirit, and when his horse stumbled he remounted and pressed on, killing more of the enemy than anyone else; the throne singled him out for special praise.

sentences.zh: 五年，授正紅旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed vice commander of the Mongolian Plain Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was appointed vice commander of the Mongolian Plain Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 江油新店子及馬蹄岡之戰，並分當一路，瀕危，克捷。

translations.literal: At the battles of Xindianzi in Jiangyou and Matigang he each took one route, faced mortal danger, and won victory.
translations.idiomatic: At Xindianzi in Jiangyou and at Matigang he each commanded a separate column, faced grave danger, and still carried the day.

sentences.zh: 冉天元餘黨與張子聰、庹向瑤等合竄潼河西岸，追及渡口，殲其後隊千餘，迭敗賊於蓬溪、中江。

translations.literal: Remnants of Ran Tianyuan joined Zhang Zicong, Tuo Xiangyao, and others in fleeing to the west bank of the Tong River; he overtook them at the ford, destroyed their rearguard of more than a thousand, and repeatedly defeated the rebels at Pengxi and Zhongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Remnants of Ran Tianyuan joined Zhang Zicong, Tuo Xiangyao, and others west of the Tong River; he caught them at the ford, wiped out more than a thousand in the rearguard, and defeated them again and again at Pengxi and Zhongjiang.

sentences.zh: 秋，偕賽衝阿擊鮮大川於新場，偕薛大烈擊湯思蛟於倒流水，從勒保擊庹向瑤於長壩，皆捷。

translations.literal: In autumn, with Sai Chong'a he attacked Xian Dachuan at Xinchang; with Xue Dalie he attacked Tang Sijiao at Daoliushui; following Lebao he struck Tuo Xiangyao at Changba—all victories.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, with Sai Chong'a he defeated Xian Dachuan at Xinchang; with Xue Dalie he defeated Tang Sijiao at Daoliushui; and with Lebao he defeated Tuo Xiangyao at Changba—winning every engagement.

sentences.zh: 六年，偕賽衝阿殲徐天德。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, with Sai Chong'a, he destroyed Xu Tiande.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he and Sai Chong'a together destroyed Xu Tiande.

sentences.zh: 其秋，擊龍紹週於湖北境，紹週合眾萬餘，已進和岡溪，後隊攻天平寨誘戰，而伏千賊截官軍後，賽衝阿擊攻寨者，溫春扼溪口以要伏賊，遂入峽攻其中堅，大敗之，追斬紹週於岳家坪，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: That autumn he attacked Long Shaozhou in Hubei; Shaozhou had gathered more than ten thousand men and had already advanced to Hegang Stream; the rearguard assaulted Tianping Stockade to lure battle while a thousand hidden rebels cut off the government army's rear; Sai Chong'a struck those attacking the stockade while Wenchun held the stream mouth to intercept the ambush, then entered the gorge to strike the main force, routing them decisively and pursuing to kill Shaozhou at Yuejiaping; he was granted the hereditary office of Commandant of Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn he fought Long Shaozhou in Hubei. Shaozhou had rallied more than ten thousand men and advanced to Hegang Stream; his rearguard attacked Tianping Stockade as bait while a thousand hidden rebels cut off the imperial force from behind. Sai Chong'a struck the stockade assault while Wenchun held the stream mouth to block the ambush, then drove into the gorge against the main rebel body and won a crushing victory, pursuing to kill Shaozhou at Yuejiaping; Wenchun was granted the hereditary rank of Commandant of Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 七年，偕賽衝阿敗劉朝選於土黃壩，分兵破庹文正於潘家槽，擒之；

translations.literal: In the seventh year, with Sai Chong'a, he defeated Liu Chaoxuan at Tuhuang Dam, detached troops to break Tuo Wenzheng at Panjiacao, and captured him;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he and Sai Chong'a defeated Liu Chaoxuan at Tuhuang Dam, detached a column to break Tuo Wenzheng at Panjiacao, and captured him;

sentences.zh: 又偕賽衝阿破樊人傑於平河口腦，陣斬其弟人禮及二子，人傑走死。

translations.literal: again with Sai Chong'a he broke Fan Renjie at Pingkouhenao, killed his younger brother Renli and two sons in battle, and Renjie fled to his death.
translations.idiomatic: and again with Sai Chong'a he broke Fan Renjie at Pingkouhenao, killing Renjie's younger brother Renli and two sons on the field; Renjie fled and perished.

sentences.zh: 是年功蕆，被優賚。

translations.literal: That year the campaign concluded and he received exceptional rewards.
translations.idiomatic: When the year's campaign ended he received exceptional rewards from the throne.

sentences.zh: 凱旋，授虎槍長、正紅旗護軍統領。

translations.literal: On his triumphal return he was appointed tiger-gun captain and commander of the garrison guard of the Plain Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: On his return in triumph he was appointed tiger-gun captain and commander of the Plain Red Banner garrison guard.

sentences.zh: 十一年，寧陝兵變，赴陝協剿。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, when the Ningshan troops mutinied, he went to Shaanxi to assist in suppression.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, when the Ningshan garrison mutinied, he went to Shaanxi to help suppress them.

sentences.zh: 十五年，充烏里雅蘇台參贊大臣，行抵烏蘭博木圖，病卒，帝憫之，命其子護喪歸，予祭葬。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he served as assistant governor at Uliastai; on reaching Ulanbomutu he died of illness; the emperor pitied him, ordered his son to escort the coffin home, and granted funeral sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was appointed assistant governor at Uliastai; he fell ill and died at Ulanbomutu. The emperor was moved to pity, ordered his son to escort the coffin home, and granted state funeral honors.

sentences.zh: 子烏凝襲世職​​，官至護軍參領。

translations.literal: His son Wuning inherited the hereditary office and rose to deputy commander of the garrison guard.
translations.idiomatic: His son Wuning inherited the family rank and eventually reached the post of deputy commander of the garrison guard.

sentences.zh: 色爾滾，莫爾丹氏，黑龍江正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Se'ergun, of the Mo'erdan clan, was a Heilongjiang Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Se'ergun, of the Mo'erdan clan, was a Heilongjiang bannerman of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 由打牲兵襲佐領。

translations.literal: From the rank of hunting soldier he inherited the assistant commandantcy.
translations.idiomatic: Starting as a hunting soldier, he inherited the post of assistant commandant.

sentences.zh: 從征廓爾喀，以功賜號托默歡武巴圖魯，遷副總管。

translations.literal: In the campaign against Gurkha he was granted the title Tomohuanwu Baturu for merit and promoted to deputy commandant.
translations.idiomatic: He served in the Nepal campaign, received the title Tomohuanwu Baturu for his achievements, and was promoted to deputy commandant.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年，從德楞泰剿教匪。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiaqing he followed Delengtai in suppressing the sect rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jiaqing he joined Delengtai's campaign against the sect rebels.

sentences.zh: 三年，殲齊王氏、姚之富於鄖西，​​受槍傷，擢協領。

translations.literal: In the third year he destroyed Qi the Wang and Yao Zhifu in western Yun, was wounded by gunfire, and was promoted to assistant commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he wiped out Qi the Wang and Yao Zhifu in western Yun, was wounded by musket fire, and was promoted to assistant commander.

sentences.zh: 合攻箕山，破賊於順水寺、郭家廟、廖家碥，及賊由青觀山敗竄，要擊於濛子灘，擒羅其清，又敗冉文儔於麻壩寨。

translations.literal: In the joint assault on Jishan he defeated rebels at Shunshui Temple, Guojia Temple, and Liaojia Bank; when rebels fled in defeat from Qingguan Mountain he intercepted them at Mengzi Beach and captured Luo Qiqing, and again defeated Ran Wenfu at Maba Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: In the joint attack on Jishan he broke the rebels at Shunshui Temple, Guojia Temple, and Liaojia Bank; when they fled in defeat from Qingguan Mountain he cut them off at Mengzi Beach and captured Luo Qiqing, then defeated Ran Wenfu at Maba Stockade.

sentences.zh: 四年春，擢總管。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year he was promoted to commandant.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year he was promoted to commandant.

sentences.zh: 從德楞泰入陝，破高均德於大市川，擒之，色爾滾戰功居最。

translations.literal: Following Delengtai into Shaanxi, he defeated Gao Junde at Dashichuan and captured him; Se'ergun's battle merit ranked foremost.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Delengtai into Shaanxi, broke Gao Junde at Dashichuan, and took him prisoner; Se'ergun's merit in the action ranked first.

sentences.zh: 五年，從戰馬蹄岡，冉天元負創逸，追至包家溝，天元就擒，又敗賊於石門寨、風如井、鐵山關，加副都統銜。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he fought at Matigang; Ran Tianyuan fled wounded, was pursued to Baojia Gully, and was captured; he again defeated rebels at Shimen Stockade, Fengrujing, and Tieshanguan, and was given the brevet rank of vice commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he fought at Matigang; Ran Tianyuan fled wounded, was run down to Baojia Gully and captured; he then defeated the rebels at Shimen Stockade, Fengrujing, and Tieshanguan and received the brevet rank of vice commander.

sentences.zh: 夏，截擊劉朝選於東鄉茨竹林，躡擊張子聰等於九亭場，進搗通江長池壩冉天士賊巢，皆敗之。

translations.literal: In summer he intercepted Liu Chaoxuan at Cizhulin in Dongxiang, pursued Zhang Zicong and others at Jiutingchang, and advanced to storm Ran Tianshi's lair at Changchi Dam in Tongjiang—all victories.
translations.idiomatic: In summer he intercepted Liu Chaoxuan at Cizhulin in Dongxiang, pursued Zhang Zicong and others at Jiutingchang, and stormed Ran Tianshi's nest at Changchi Dam in Tongjiang, winning every engagement.

sentences.zh: 秋，剿鮮大川、苟文明於巴州元口鎮，沿江兜截，與大軍合擊，斬賊渠吳耀國、鮮文炳，擒苟文禮。

translations.literal: In autumn he suppressed Xian Dachuan and Gou Wenming at Yuankou Town in Bazhou, blocked them along the river, joined the main army in attack, beheaded the rebel chiefs Wu Yaoguo and Xian Wenbing, and captured Gou Wenli.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn he hunted Xian Dachuan and Gou Wenming at Yuankou Town in Bazhou, blocked them along the river, joined the main force in battle, killed the rebel leaders Wu Yaoguo and Xian Wenbing, and captured Gou Wenli.

sentences.zh: 又擊湯思蛟、趙麻花於茅坪、倒流水。

translations.literal: He again attacked Tang Sijiao and Zhao Ma'hua at Maoping and Daoliushui.
translations.idiomatic: He also fought Tang Sijiao and Zhao Ma'hua at Maoping and Daoliushui.

sentences.zh: 冬，殲麻花於大禾田，被獎敘。

translations.literal: In winter he destroyed Ma'hua at Dahetian and received commendation in the merit rolls.
translations.idiomatic: In winter he wiped out Ma'hua at Dahetian and was entered on the rolls for special reward.

sentences.zh: 六年，從德楞泰入陝，擒龔如一、高天升；

translations.literal: In the sixth year, following Delengtai into Shaanxi, he captured Gong Ruyi and Gao Tiansheng;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he followed Delengtai into Shaanxi and captured Gong Ruyi and Gao Tiansheng;

sentences.zh: 合擊龍紹週、徐天德，先後擒殲。

translations.literal: in joint operations against Long Shaozhou and Xu Tiande he captured and destroyed them in succession.
translations.idiomatic: in joint operations against Long Shaozhou and Xu Tiande he captured and destroyed them one after another.

sentences.zh: 冬，擊苟文明於槽子溝，陷陣被創。

translations.literal: In winter he attacked Gou Wenming at Caozigou, plunged into the battle line, and was wounded.
translations.idiomatic: In winter he attacked Gou Wenming at Caozigou, charged into the thick of the fight, and was wounded.

sentences.zh: 七年，從德楞泰追樊人傑入楚，馳三百里繞其前；

translations.literal: In the seventh year he followed Delengtai in pursuing Fan Renjie into Huguang, riding three hundred li to get ahead of him;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he followed Delengtai in pursuit of Fan Renjie into Huguang, riding three hundred li to cut in ahead of him;

sentences.zh: 又偕蒲尚佐破蒲天寶於鮑家山，徒步入賊巢，天寶走死。

translations.literal: again with Pushangzuo he broke Pu Tianbao at Baojiashan, entered the rebel nest on foot, and Tianbao fled to his death.
translations.idiomatic: and with Pushangzuo he broke Pu Tianbao at Baojiashan, entered the rebel stronghold on foot, and Tianbao fled to his death.

sentences.zh: 詔嘉其奮勇，命在乾清門侍衛行走。

translations.literal: An edict praised his daring and ordered him to serve as an attendant guard at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: The throne praised his valor and appointed him to serve as an attendant guard at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 又殲戴仕傑於興山施家溝。

translations.literal: He again destroyed Dai Shijie at Shijiagou in Xingshan.
translations.idiomatic: He also destroyed Dai Shijie at Shijiagou in Xingshan.

sentences.zh: 八年，搜剿餘匪，肅清，被優敘。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he searched out and suppressed remnant bandits until the region was cleared, and received exceptional entry in the merit rolls.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he hunted down the remaining rebels until the region was pacified and received exceptional commendation.

sentences.zh: 歷阿勒楚克副都統、伊犁領隊大臣。

translations.literal: He successively served as vice commander at Aletuke and expeditionary minister at Ili.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as vice commander at Aletuke and expeditionary minister at Ili.

sentences.zh: 十四年，叛兵蒲大芳等在戍所煽亂，將軍松筠令色爾滾往誅之，詔嘉所使得人，召來京，授鑲藍旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year the mutineers Pu Dafang and others stirred up trouble at the garrison post; General Songyun ordered Se'ergun to go and execute them; an edict praised his choice of the right man, summoned him to the capital, and appointed him vice commander of the Mongolian Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year the mutineers Pu Dafang and others incited trouble at the garrison; General Songyun sent Se'ergun to put them down; the throne praised his selection of the right man, recalled him to the capital, and appointed him vice commander of the Mongolian Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 歷伯都訥、阿勒楚克副都統。

translations.literal: He successively served as vice commander at Boduna and Aletuke.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as vice commander at Boduna and Aletuke.

sentences.zh: 十八年，命協剿滑縣教匪李文成，遁，設伏白土岡敗之。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was ordered to assist in suppressing the sect rebel Li Wencheng at Huaxian; Wencheng fled, and he set an ambush at Baitu Hill and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he was ordered to help suppress the Huaxian sect rebel Li Wencheng; when Wencheng fled, he laid an ambush at Baitu Hill and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 賊固守司寨，毀垣入，登樓殺賊，文成自焚死，加都統銜，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: The rebels held firm in the commissioner stockade; he broke through the wall, mounted the tower to kill rebels, and Wencheng burned himself to death; he was given the brevet rank of commander and granted the hereditary office of Commandant of Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels held the commissioner stockade; he breached the wall, climbed the tower to kill the defenders, and Wencheng burned himself to death; he received the brevet rank of commander and the hereditary rank of Commandant of Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 歷黑龍江副都統、呼倫貝爾辦事大臣。

translations.literal: He successively served as Heilongjiang vice commander and commissioner for Hulun Buir affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as Heilongjiang vice commander and commissioner for Hulun Buir affairs.

sentences.zh: 道光七年，乞病，給全俸。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Daoguang he asked leave on grounds of illness and was granted full salary.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Daoguang he retired on account of illness with full pay.

sentences.zh: 十三年，卒，賜金治喪，諡壯勇。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he died; funds were granted for the funeral, and he was given the posthumous name Zhuangyong.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he died; the court granted funds for his funeral and gave him the posthumous name Zhuangyong.

sentences.zh: 子明晉，孫濟克扎布，襲佐領兼雲騎尉。

translations.literal: His son Mingjin and grandson Jikezhabu inherited the assistant commandantcy together with Commandant of Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: His son Mingjin and grandson Jikezhabu inherited the assistant commandantcy together with the rank of Commandant of Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 蘇爾慎，蘇都里氏，滿洲正黃旗人，黑龍江馬甲。

translations.literal: Su'ershen, of the Suduli clan, was a Heilongjiang cavalry soldier of the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Su'ershen, of the Suduli clan, was a Heilongjiang cavalryman of the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 從征廓爾喀。

translations.literal: He followed the campaign against Gurkha.
translations.idiomatic: He served in the Nepal campaign.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶初，從德楞泰剿教匪，積功授三等侍衛，改隸京旗。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jiaqing he followed Delengtai in suppressing sect rebels, and through accumulated merit was appointed third-class bodyguard and transferred to the capital banners.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Jiaqing he joined Delengtai against the sect rebels; his accumulated merit won him appointment as third-class bodyguard and transfer to the capital banners.

sentences.zh: 五年，馬蹄岡之戰，初不利。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, at the battle of Matigang, the situation was at first unfavorable.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, at the battle of Matigang, the imperial side was at first hard pressed.

sentences.zh: 德楞泰憩山上，賊至，馳下奮擊，蘇爾慎射冉天元馬，應弦倒，天元就擒，賊遂大潰。

translations.literal: Delengtai was resting on the mountain when rebels arrived; he galloped down to fight fiercely; Su'ershen shot Ran Tianyuan's horse, which fell at the bowstring's release; Tianyuan was captured and the rebels broke in great rout.
translations.idiomatic: Delengtai was resting on the hill when the rebels came up; he galloped down to counterattack. Su'ershen shot Ran Tianyuan's horse, which dropped at the bowstring's twang; Tianyuan was taken and the rebels fled in complete rout.

sentences.zh: 論功最，擢二等侍衛、乾清門行走。

translations.literal: His merit was judged foremost; he was promoted to second-class bodyguard and service at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: His merit was judged the greatest in the action; he was promoted to second-class bodyguard and service at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 其冬，攻大埡口，陷陣被創，賜號西林巴圖魯。

translations.literal: That winter, assaulting Dayakou, he plunged into the battle line and was wounded, and was granted the title Xilin Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the assault on Dayakou, he charged into the thick of the fight and was wounded; he received the title Xilin Baturu.

sentences.zh: 六年，戰紅花垛、鯽魚埡，追賊至陝境黃石坂，首先躍馬衝入賊陣，擒賊渠龐士應、方文魁，尋殲徐天德、樊人傑、苟朝獻，戰皆力。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he fought at Honghuaduo and Jiyuya, pursued rebels to Huangshiban on the Shaanxi border, was first to leap his horse into the rebel formation, captured the rebel chiefs Pang Shiying and Fang Wenkui, and soon destroyed Xu Tiande, Fan Renjie, and Gou Chaoxian—fighting with full force in every battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he fought at Honghuaduo and Jiyuya and pursued the rebels to Huangshiban on the Shaanxi border, where he was the first to charge into the enemy ranks on horseback, capturing the chiefs Pang Shiying and Fang Wenkui, then destroying Xu Tiande, Fan Renjie, and Gou Chaoxian—giving his utmost in every engagement.

sentences.zh: 七年，破鳳皇山、雞公梁、桂林坪，先登奪隘，軍中號為勇敢。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he broke the enemy at Fenghuang Mountain, Jigong Ridge, and Guilinping, was first to scale and seize the passes, and the army called him brave.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he defeated the enemy at Fenghuang Mountain, Jigong Ridge, and Guilinping, was first over the passes in each assault, and the army hailed him as the bravest of them all.

sentences.zh: 凱旋，擢頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: On his triumphal return he was promoted to first-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: On his return in triumph he was promoted to first-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 十八年，林清黨犯禁城，聞警入，首先殺賊，加副都統銜，命為領隊大臣，率巴圖魯侍衛赴山東剿教匪。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year Lin Qing's faction attacked the Forbidden City; hearing the alarm he entered and was first to kill rebels; he was given the brevet rank of vice commander, appointed expeditionary minister, and led Baturu bodyguards to Shandong to suppress sect rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year Lin Qing's faction stormed the Forbidden City; Su'ershen rushed in at the alarm and was first to kill the attackers. He received the brevet rank of vice commander, was appointed expeditionary minister, and led Baturu guards to Shandong against the sect rebels.

sentences.zh: 詔稱其材武出眾，可當百人，愛惜之，戒勿步戰。

translations.literal: An edict declared his martial talent outstanding, worth a hundred men, cherished him, and warned him not to fight on foot.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared that his martial prowess was worth a hundred ordinary men, cherished him, and warned him not to fight on foot.

sentences.zh: 破曹州、武定賊巢十一，复偕提督馬瑜破賊於滑縣潘章村，擒賊目郭明山。

translations.literal: He broke eleven rebel nests at Caozhou and Wuding, and again with Provincial Commander Ma Yu defeated rebels at Panzhang Village in Huaxian and captured the rebel chief Guo Mingshan.
translations.idiomatic: He overran eleven rebel nests at Caozhou and Wuding, and with Provincial Commander Ma Yu defeated the rebels at Panzhang Village in Huaxian and captured the rebel leader Guo Mingshan.

sentences.zh: 事定回京，授鑲紅旗蒙古副都統，充上書房諳達。

translations.literal: When affairs were settled he returned to the capital and was appointed vice commander of the Mongolian Bordered Red Banner and interpreter in the Upper Study.
translations.idiomatic: When the campaign ended he returned to the capital, was appointed vice commander of the Mongolian Bordered Red Banner, and served as interpreter in the Upper Study.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，上幸熱河，乘馬蹶，蘇爾慎控止之，擢鑲藍旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, when the emperor visited Rehe, his mount stumbled; Su'ershen checked and steadied it, and was promoted to commander of the Mongolian Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, when the emperor was at Rehe, his horse stumbled; Su'ershen steadied the mount and was promoted to commander of the Mongolian Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，隨扈昌陵，馬逸，突乘輿，降藍翎侍衛。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daoguang, while escorting the Changling mausoleum, a horse bolted and rushed at the imperial carriage; he was demoted to blue-plume bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Daoguang, while escorting the imperial party at the Changling mausoleum, a horse bolted toward the carriage; he was demoted to blue-plume bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 逾年，以二等侍衛休致。

translations.literal: After a year he retired on the rank of second-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: A year later he retired with the rank of second-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 未幾，卒，贈副都統銜。

translations.literal: He soon died and was posthumously granted the brevet rank of vice commander.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon afterward and was posthumously granted the brevet rank of vice commander.

sentences.zh: 阿哈保，鄂拉氏，滿洲正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Ahabao, of the Ela clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Ahabao, of the Ela clan, was a Manchu bannerman of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 由司轡護軍授侍衛。

translations.literal: From the rank of bridle-guard he was appointed bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: Starting as a bridle-guard in the garrison, he was appointed imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 從征台灣，解諸羅圍，擒林爽文，賜號錫特洪阿巴圖魯，圖形紫光閣。

translations.literal: In the Taiwan campaign he relieved the siege of Zhuluo, captured Lin Shuangwen, was granted the title Xitehong'a Baturu, and had his portrait placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taiwan campaign he lifted the siege of Zhuluo and captured Lin Shuangwen, received the title Xitehong'a Baturu, and was honored with a portrait in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 繼從征廓爾喀，擢二等侍衛。

translations.literal: He next followed the Gurkha campaign and was promoted to second-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: He next served in the Nepal campaign and was promoted to second-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 苗疆事起，轉戰最力，論功居上等，迭擢頭等侍衛、正黃旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: When the Miao frontier troubles arose he fought with greatest effort; his merit was judged in the highest class, and he was repeatedly promoted to first-class bodyguard and vice commander of the Mongolian Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When the Miao frontier rebellion broke out he fought with exceptional vigor; his merit was ranked in the highest class, and he rose in succession to first-class bodyguard and vice commander of the Mongolian Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年，命率吉林兵赴襄陽，偕景安剿教匪，擊賊於獨樹塘、楓樹埡，擒斬甚眾。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiaqing he was ordered to lead Jilin troops to Xiangyang, joined Jing'an in suppressing sect rebels, struck them at Dushutang and Fengshuya, and killed and captured a great many.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jiaqing he was ordered to lead Jilin troops to Xiangyang, joined Jing'an against the sect rebels, and struck them at Dushutang and Fengshuya, killing and capturing a great many.

sentences.zh: 三年，追賊入川，合攻大神山，分克插旗山賊卡，盡殲之。

translations.literal: In the third year he pursued rebels into Sichuan, joined in the assault on Dashen Mountain, took in detachments the rebel posts on Chaqi Mountain, and destroyed them all.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he pursued the rebels into Sichuan, joined the assault on Dashen Mountain, captured the rebel posts on Chaqi Mountain in separate columns, and wiped them out.

sentences.zh: 四年，命擊徐天德於渠河，又破之於譚家壩，賊大潰。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was ordered to attack Xu Tiande at Quhe, again defeated him at Tanjiaba, and the rebels broke in great rout.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was ordered against Xu Tiande at Quhe, defeated him again at Tanjiaba, and put the rebels to rout.

sentences.zh: 冬，設伏白水碉，殲賊千餘，被獎敘。

translations.literal: In winter he set an ambush at Baishuidiao and destroyed more than a thousand rebels, receiving commendation in the merit rolls.
translations.idiomatic: In winter he ambushed the enemy at Baishuidiao and destroyed more than a thousand rebels, earning entry on the rolls for reward.

sentences.zh: 五年，冉天元等犯川西，御之場院，失利，責領新到貴州兵戴罪立功。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Ran Tianyuan and others invaded western Sichuan; he met them at Changyuan, suffered defeat, and was ordered to lead newly arrived Guizhou troops to redeem his fault with merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Ran Tianyuan and others invaded western Sichuan; he met them at Changyuan, was defeated, and was ordered to lead the newly arrived Guizhou troops to redeem himself with merit.

sentences.zh: 從德楞泰擊天元，獨當火石埡一路，先敗後勝。

translations.literal: Following Delengtai against Tianyuan, he alone held the Huoshi'ya route, suffering defeat before victory.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Delengtai against Tianyuan, holding the Huoshi'ya route alone; after an initial reverse he won the day.

sentences.zh: 冬，偕薛大烈擊楊開第於安仁溪山梁，追越大山數重，至兩台山，所過賊寨皆下，開第伏誅，被優賚，擢御前侍衛。

translations.literal: In winter, with Xue Dalie, he attacked Yang Kaidi on the mountain ridge at Anren Stream, pursued over several ranges of great mountains to Liangtai Mountain, took every rebel stockade along the way, and Kaidi was executed; he received exceptional rewards and was promoted to imperial bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In winter he and Xue Dalie attacked Yang Kaidi on the ridge at Anren Stream, pursued him over range after range to Liangtai Mountain, and captured every rebel stockade along the way; Kaidi was executed, Ahabao received exceptional rewards, and was promoted to imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 六年秋，复偕大烈擊青、黃、藍三號賊於巴州石鐍山，分路設伏，夜襲之，殲戮二千餘，授正紅旗護軍統領，並賜其子阿顏托克託為藍翎侍衛。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the sixth year he again joined Dalie against the Green, Yellow, and Blue rebel bands at Shijueshan in Bazhou, set ambushes on separate routes, and raided them by night, killing more than two thousand; he was appointed commander of the Plain Red Banner garrison guard, and his son Ayantuoketuo was granted the rank of blue-plume bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the sixth year he again joined Dalie against the Green, Yellow, and Blue rebel bands at Shijueshan in Bazhou, laid ambushes on separate routes, and attacked by night, killing more than two thousand; he was appointed commander of the Plain Red Banner garrison guard, and his son Ayantuoketuo was granted the rank of blue-plume bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 搜剿老林，擒老教首鄧金祥，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: Searching the old forests, he captured the old sect leader Deng Jinxiang and was granted the hereditary office of Commandant of Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Searching the deep forests, he captured the veteran sect leader Deng Jinxiang and was granted the hereditary rank of Commandant of Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 尋合擊高見奇等於大茅坪，因病赴達州醫療。

translations.literal: Soon he joined in attacking Gao Jianqi and others at Damaoping, then went to Dazhou for medical treatment on account of illness.
translations.idiomatic: He soon joined the attack on Gao Jianqi and others at Damaoping, then went to Dazhou for treatment of an illness.

sentences.zh: 七年，召回京。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was recalled to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was recalled to the capital.

sentences.zh: 逾歲，以扈駕神武門，陳德突禦輿，失於防護，褫職，予副都統銜，在乾清門行走。

translations.literal: After a year, while escorting the imperial carriage at the Gate of Divine Prowess, Chen De suddenly rushed at the palanquin; failing in protection, he was stripped of office, granted the brevet rank of vice commander, and assigned to service at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: A year later, while escorting the emperor at the Gate of Divine Prowess, Chen De rushed at the carriage; for failing to prevent the assault he was stripped of office, granted the brevet rank of vice commander, and assigned to the Gate of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 歷正白旗蒙古副都統、正紅旗護軍統領。

translations.literal: He successively served as vice commander of the Mongolian Plain White Banner and commander of the Plain Red Banner garrison guard.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as vice commander of the Mongolian Plain White Banner and commander of the Plain Red Banner garrison guard.

sentences.zh: 十年，病，加都統銜，遂卒，依都統例賜卹。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, ill, he was given the brevet rank of commander, then died, and funeral compensation was granted according to the commander precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, while ill, he was granted the brevet rank of commander; he died soon after, and funeral compensation was granted according to the precedent for a commander.

sentences.zh: 子阿顏托克托襲世職，兼三等侍衛。

translations.literal: His son Ayantuoketuo inherited the hereditary office and also held the rank of third-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: His son Ayantuoketuo inherited the family rank and also served as third-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 綸布春，羅佳氏，滿洲鑲白旗人。

translations.literal: Lunbuchun, of the Luojia clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Lunbuchun, of the Luojia clan, was a Manchu bannerman of the Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 以黑龍江學圍駐京，授司轡。

translations.literal: As a Heilongjiang student of the hunt he was stationed in the capital and appointed bridle-guard.
translations.idiomatic: Trained in the Heilongjiang hunting service and posted to the capital, he was appointed bridle-guard.

sentences.zh: 從征廓爾喀、苗疆，賜號色默爾亨巴圖魯。

translations.literal: He followed campaigns in Gurkha and the Miao frontier and was granted the title Semo'erheng Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: He served in Nepal and on the Miao frontier and received the title Semo'erheng Baturu.

sentences.zh: 累擢二等侍衛。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to second-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through repeated promotions to second-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，裹創克騾馬岡險隘，加副都統銜。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing, wounded, he took the difficult pass at Luomagang and was given the brevet rank of vice commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiaqing, though wounded, he captured the difficult pass at Luomagang and received the brevet rank of vice commander.

sentences.zh: 平隴賊寨尤固，綸布春從獅子坡入，囊土填壕，毀牆柵，出間道撫其背，大軍進薄石隆，遂擒石柳鄧。

translations.literal: The Pinglong rebel stockade was especially strong; Lunbuchun entered from Shizipo, bagged earth to fill the moat, destroyed walls and palisades, and came by a hidden path to take them from behind; the main army pressed close to Shilong, and Shi Liudeng was captured.
translations.idiomatic: The Pinglong stockade was especially strong; Lunbuchun entered from Shizipo, had his men fill the moat with bagged earth, broke down the walls and palisades, and took a hidden path to strike the enemy from behind while the main army closed on Shilong and captured Shi Liudeng.

sentences.zh: 二年，苗平，從額勒登保剿湖北教匪，破林之華於芭葉山，追賊紅土溪、鐵礦坡、羅鍋圈，迭敗之，授鑲藍旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: In the second year, when the Miao were pacified, he followed Eledengbao in suppressing Hubei sect rebels, defeated Lin Zhihua at Bayeshan, pursued rebels through Hongtuxi, Tiekupo, and Luoguoquan, repeatedly defeating them, and was appointed vice commander of the Mongolian Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, after the Miao were pacified, he followed Eledengbao against the Hubei sect rebels, defeated Lin Zhihua at Bayeshan, and pursued the enemy through Hongtuxi, Tiekupo, and Luoguoquan, winning repeated victories; he was appointed vice commander of the Mongolian Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 三年，擒覃加耀於終報寨，移軍入川，敗高均德於野豬坪，擊李全等於紫泥嶺。

translations.literal: In the third year he captured Qin Jiayao at Zhongbao Stockade, moved his army into Sichuan, defeated Gao Junde at Yezhuping, and attacked Li Quan and others at Ziniling.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he captured Qin Jiayao at Zhongbao Stockade, marched into Sichuan, defeated Gao Junde at Yezhuping, and attacked Li Quan and others at Ziniling.

sentences.zh: 賊走湖北，額勒登保自漢江下襄陽，令綸布春將騎兵由陸出平利。

translations.literal: The rebels fled to Hubei; Eledengbao went down the Han River to Xiangyang and ordered Lunbuchun to lead cavalry overland out through Pingli.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled into Hubei; Eledengbao descended the Han to Xiangyang and ordered Lunbuchun to lead the cavalry overland through Pingli.

sentences.zh: 遇張漢潮於南漳，敗之於菩提河、孟石嶺，殲賊數千。

translations.literal: He met Zhang Hanchao at Nanzhang, defeated him at Puti River and Mengshiling, and destroyed several thousand rebels.
translations.idiomatic: He met Zhang Hanchao at Nanzhang, defeated him at Puti River and Mengshiling, and killed several thousand of the enemy.

sentences.zh: 尋，漢潮與詹世爵、李槐合，眾可二萬，偕明亮扼之清池子山口，漢潮先遁，世爵、槐於隘口抗拒，綸布春以勁騎截擊，木石並發，賊窘，多觸崖死，世爵、槐並殲焉。

translations.literal: Soon Hanchao joined Zhan Shijue and Li Huai, their forces numbering perhaps twenty thousand; with Mingliang he blocked them at Qingchizi Mountain Pass; Hanchao fled first; Shijue and Huai resisted at the defile; Lunbuchun sent crack cavalry to intercept, rolling down timber and stone together; the rebels were cornered, many dying on the cliffs, and Shijue and Huai were both destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Hanchao joined Zhan Shijue and Li Huai, their combined force numbering perhaps twenty thousand; with Mingliang he blocked them at Qingchizi Pass. Hanchao fled first; Shijue and Huai held the defile. Lunbuchun sent elite cavalry to cut them off while timber and stones rained down; trapped, many rebels died on the cliffs, and both Shijue and Huai were destroyed.

sentences.zh: 秋，從額勒登保擊高均德於吳家河口，賊自林中出，矛傷左脅，力戰敗之。

translations.literal: In autumn, following Eledengbao, he attacked Gao Junde at Wujiahe Mouth; rebels burst from the forest and a spear wounded his left side, but he fought fiercely and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn he followed Eledengbao against Gao Junde at Wujiahe Mouth; rebels burst from the forest and a spear wounded his left side, but he fought on and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 進攻張公橋，擒漢潮子正漋及劉朝佐等。

translations.literal: Advancing to attack Zhanggong Bridge, he captured Hanchao's son Zhengzheng and Liu Chaozuo and others.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing the attack at Zhanggong Bridge, he captured Hanchao's son Zhengzheng and Liu Chaozuo and others.

sentences.zh: 四年春，械送諸賊至京，命偕侍衛十八人解餉回川，坐報侍衛等患病失實，降黜。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year the captives were sent in bonds to the capital; he was ordered, with eighteen bodyguards, to escort pay supplies back to Sichuan; for falsely reporting that bodyguards and others were ill he was demoted.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year the captives were sent in chains to the capital; he was ordered, with eighteen bodyguards, to escort pay supplies back to Sichuan; for falsely reporting that the bodyguards were ill he was demoted.

sentences.zh: 未幾，敗漢潮於黃牛鋪，諸軍合擊之張家坪，漢潮就殲，綸布春獲其屍，擢乾清門侍衛。

translations.literal: Before long he defeated Hanchao at Huangniupu; the armies combined to strike him at Zhangjiaping, and Hanchao was destroyed; Lunbuchun obtained his corpse and was promoted to bodyguard at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he defeated Hanchao at Huangniupu; the allied armies cornered him at Zhangjiaping and destroyed him; Lunbuchun recovered his body and was promoted to bodyguard at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 迭破餘賊於教場壩、藥壩、茨溝、板房子，那彥成疏陳戰績超眾，屢詔褒賚。

translations.literal: He repeatedly defeated remnant rebels at Jiaochangba, Yaoba, Cigou, and Banfangzi; Nayancheng memorialized that his battle record surpassed others, and repeated edicts praised and rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: He defeated remnant rebels in succession at Jiaochangba, Yaoba, Cigou, and Banfangzi; Nayancheng reported that his record surpassed all others, and repeated edicts praised and rewarded him.

sentences.zh: 五年，隨那彥成出寶雞，遏白號賊北犯，破之於龍山鎮，授鑲黃旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed Nayancheng out of Baoji, blocked the White-Banner rebels from invading north, defeated them at Longshan Town, and was appointed vice commander of the Mongolian Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he followed Nayancheng out of Baoji, blocked the White-Banner rebels from pushing north, defeated them at Longshan Town, and was appointed vice commander of the Mongolian Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 黃號賊分屯，連營十餘裡，綸布春潛師先破八里灣，回擊牛氾嶺，賊傍秀金山列隊以拒，徑衝入陣，手刃數賊，遽卻；

translations.literal: The Yellow-Banner rebels were encamped in divisions with camps stretching more than ten li; Lunbuchun sent a hidden force to break Balawan first, then turned to strike Niufanling; the rebels drew up in ranks along Xiujin Mountain to resist; he charged straight into the formation, personally killed several rebels, and abruptly withdrew;
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow-Banner rebels were encamped in divisions along a line more than ten li long; Lunbuchun sent a concealed force to break Balawan first, then turned to strike Niufanling. The rebels formed ranks along Xiujin Mountain to resist; he charged straight into the line, killed several with his own hand, and abruptly withdrew;

sentences.zh: 進援卡狼寨，扼石峽口夾擊，大敗之。

translations.literal: advancing to relieve Kalang Stockade, he held Shixia Pass and struck from both sides, routing them decisively.
translations.idiomatic: then advanced to relieve Kalang Stockade, held Shixia Pass, and struck from both sides in a crushing victory.

sentences.zh: 夏，偕穆克登布擊楊開甲於七盤溝，而高天德、馬學禮犯漢中，提督王文雄戰死，詔責綸布春專剿，敗之於白溪。

translations.literal: In summer, with Mukedengbu, he attacked Yang Kaijia at Qipangou; meanwhile Gao Tiande and Ma Xueli invaded Hanzhong, Provincial Commander Wang Wenxiong died in battle, an edict charged Lunbuchun with exclusive pursuit, and he defeated them at Baixi.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, with Mukedengbu, he attacked Yang Kaijia at Qipangou; meanwhile Gao Tiande and Ma Xueli invaded Hanzhong and Provincial Commander Wang Wenxiong was killed in battle. An edict charged Lunbuchun with exclusive pursuit of the invaders, and he defeated them at Baixi.

sentences.zh: 俄，冉學勝渡漢北，將與伍懷志合，偕總兵汪啟邀擊於留壩，又會諸軍敗之於太吉河、魚洞河。

translations.literal: Soon Ran Xuesheng crossed north of the Han to join Wu Huaizhi; with Brigadier Wang Qi he intercepted them at Liuba, and again joined the armies to defeat them at Taiji River and Yudong River.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Ran Xuesheng crossed north of the Han to join Wu Huaizhi; with Brigadier Wang Qi he intercepted them at Liuba, and with the other armies defeated them at Taiji River and Yudong River.

sentences.zh: 六年春，以追剿學勝久無功，被劾褫職，以馬甲留營效力，從穆克登布擊伍懷志於五郎鐵鎖橋，率三十人先驅衝敵，殺賊數十。

translations.literal: In the spring of the sixth year, for long pursuing Xuesheng without success, he was impeached and stripped of office, remaining as a cavalry soldier to serve in camp; following Mukedengbu he attacked Wu Huaizhi at Wulang Tiesuo Bridge, led thirty men as vanguard charging the enemy, and killed several dozen rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the sixth year, impeached for pursuing Xuesheng too long without result, he was stripped of office and remained as a common cavalryman to serve in camp; following Mukedengbu he attacked Wu Huaizhi at Wulang Tiesuo Bridge, led thirty men in a vanguard charge, and killed several dozen of the enemy.

sentences.zh: 賊據山拒鬥，躍登橫擊，賊眾披靡，追擊於紅水河，徒步奮戰，奪山梁。

translations.literal: The rebels held the mountain and resisted; he leaped up and struck across them, the rebel masses scattered, he pursued to Hongshui River, fought on foot with full effort, and seized the mountain ridge.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels held the heights and fought back; he leaped up the slope and struck across their line, sending them flying; he pursued to Hongshui River, fought on foot with desperate energy, and seized the ridge.

sentences.zh: 詔嘉其愧奮，授藍翎侍衛。

translations.literal: An edict praised his shame-driven valor and appointed him blue-plume bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: The throne praised his shame-fueled valor and appointed him blue-plume bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 复偕穆克登布躡賊，偵知潛匿老林一層窯，地險絕，督兵猱升而上，懷志與黨六七人惶急投崖下，為綸布春所獲，授二等侍衛，复巴圖魯。

translations.literal: Again with Mukedengbu he pursued the rebels, learned they were hidden in Yicengyao in the old forest on utterly difficult ground, directed troops to climb like monkeys upward; Huaizhi and six or seven followers in panic threw themselves below the cliff and were taken by Lunbuchun; he was appointed second-class bodyguard and his Baturu title was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Again with Mukedengbu he tracked the rebels to Yicengyao in the deep forest, ground so steep his men had to climb like apes; Huaizhi and six or seven followers in panic threw themselves from the cliff and were captured by Lunbuchun; he was appointed second-class bodyguard and his Baturu title was restored.

sentences.zh: 其冬，病卒於漢中，依頭等侍衛議卹。

translations.literal: That winter he died of illness at Hanzhong, and funeral compensation was deliberated according to the first-class bodyguard precedent.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he died of illness at Hanzhong, and funeral compensation was granted according to the precedent for a first-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 格布舍，鈕祜祿氏，滿洲正白旗人。

translations.literal: Geburshe, of the Niohuru clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Geburshe, of the Niohuru clan, was a Manchu bannerman of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 父薩克丹布，以吉林新滿洲留京為前鋒。

translations.literal: His father Sakdanbu, as a new Manchu from Jilin remaining in the capital, served as a vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: His father Sakdanbu, a Jilin new-banner Manchu posted to the capital, served as a vanguard.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中，從海蘭察徵石峰堡、台灣有功，累擢三等侍衛，賜號伯奇巴圖魯，圖形紫光閣。

translations.literal: In the Qianlong reign he followed Hailancha in campaigns at Shifengbao and Taiwan with merit, was repeatedly promoted to third-class bodyguard, granted the title Boqi Baturu, and had his portrait placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianlong he followed Hailancha at Shifengbao and Taiwan with distinction, rose to third-class bodyguard, received the title Boqi Baturu, and was honored with a portrait in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 又從額勒登保徵苗疆，擢二等侍衛。

translations.literal: He again followed Eledengbao in the Miao campaign and was promoted to second-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: He next followed Eledengbao in the Miao campaign and was promoted to second-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 遂從剿教匪，破芭葉山，其大金坪、抱窩山兩戰尤力。

translations.literal: He then followed the suppression of sect rebels, broke Bayeshan, and fought with especial force at the two battles of Dajinping and Baowoshan.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined the campaign against the sect rebels, captured Bayeshan, and fought with exceptional vigor at Dajinping and Baowoshan.

sentences.zh: 以病解軍事，久之始卒。

translations.literal: On account of illness he was relieved of military duties, and after a long time finally died.
translations.idiomatic: Illness forced him from active command, and only after a long decline did he die.

sentences.zh: 臨歿，仁宗念前勞，加副都統銜。

translations.literal: As death approached, the Jiaqing Emperor, recalling his past services, conferred the brevet rank of vice commander.
translations.idiomatic: On his deathbed the Jiaqing Emperor, mindful of his earlier service, granted him the brevet rank of vice commander.

sentences.zh: 格布舍亦起前鋒，累遷三等侍衛。

translations.literal: Geburshe likewise rose from the vanguard and was repeatedly promoted to third-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: Geburshe too began as a vanguard and rose through repeated promotions to third-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 隨父赴苗疆，平隴之役，從額勒登保克岩人坡、大壩角諸寨，賜號庫奇特巴圖魯。

translations.literal: Following his father to the Miao frontier, in the Pinglong campaign he followed Eledengbao in capturing Yenrenpo, Daba Jiao, and other stockades, and was granted the title Kujite Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: He followed his father to the Miao frontier and, in the Pinglong campaign, served under Eledengbao at Yenrenpo, Daba Jiao, and other stockades; for this he received the title Kujite Baturu.

sentences.zh: 及赴湖北黃柏山，戰頻有功，又殲逃賊於巫山。

translations.literal: When he went to Huangbaishan in Hubei, he won repeated merit in battle and also destroyed fleeing rebels at Wushan.
translations.idiomatic: Posted to Huangbaishan in Hubei, he fought with repeated distinction and also wiped out fleeing rebels at Wushan.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年，殲冷天祿。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing, he destroyed Leng Tianlu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Jiaqing he destroyed Leng Tianlu.

sentences.zh: 奏諸將功，格布舍第一。

translations.literal: When the generals' merits were reported, Geburshe ranked first.
translations.idiomatic: When merit among the generals was submitted, Geburshe stood first.

sentences.zh: 上夙知其將門子，善用鳥槍，特嘉經略所列公允，加副都統銜。
