translations.literal: The emperor had long known him as the son of a general and skilled with the musket; he especially approved the fairness of the grand coordinator's list and added the brevet rank of vice commander.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had long known him as a general's son and a master of the musket; he especially approved the fairness of the grand coordinator's ranking and added the brevet rank of vice commander.

sentences.zh: 五年，偕楊芳夾擊楊開甲於兩岔河，陷陣，被創墜馬，躍上再戰，追斬甚眾，予恩騎尉世職。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, with Yang Fang he attacked Yang Kaijia from both sides at Liangcha River; he broke into the enemy ranks, was wounded and fell from his horse, leaped up to fight again, pursued and killed a great many, and was granted the hereditary office of En Riding Captain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he and Yang Fang caught Yang Kaijia in a pincer at Liangcha River; Geburshe broke through the enemy line, was wounded and thrown from his horse, leaped back into the fight, and pursued the foe, killing many; he received the hereditary office of En Riding Captain.

sentences.zh: 又偕楊遇春殲伍金柱、宋國富，六年，擒王廷詔及高天德、馬學禮，功皆最，晉雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: Again with Yang Yuchun he destroyed Wu Jinzhu and Song Guofu; in the sixth year he captured Wang Tingzhao and Gao Tiande and Ma Xueli, ranking highest in merit each time, and was promoted to the hereditary office of Cloud Riding Captain.
translations.idiomatic: With Yang Yuchun he next destroyed Wu Jinzhu and Song Guofu; in the sixth year he captured Wang Tingzhao, Gao Tiande, and Ma Xueli, topping the merit rolls each time, and was promoted to the hereditary office of Cloud Riding Captain.

sentences.zh: 其冬，擊辛鬥於黑龍洞。

translations.literal: That winter he attacked Xin Dou at Heilong Cave.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he attacked Xin Dou at Heilong Cave.

sentences.zh: 七年，從額勒登保追剿苟文明，冒雨深入老林，文明就殲​​。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he followed Eledengbao in pursuing Gou Wenming, penetrated deep into the old forest in the rain, and Wenming was destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he followed Eledengbao in the pursuit of Gou Wenming, pushing through the rain deep into the old forest until Wenming was destroyed.

sentences.zh: 留川、陝邊界檢捕殘匪。

translations.literal: He remained on the Sichuan-Shaanxi border to search out and capture remnant bandits.
translations.idiomatic: He stayed on the Sichuan-Shaanxi border to hunt down remnant rebels.

sentences.zh: 凱旋，授正黃旗漢軍副都統、乾清門行走。

translations.literal: Upon triumphant return he was appointed vice commander of the Han Plain Yellow Banner and attendant at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: After his triumphant return he was made vice commander of the Han Plain Yellow Banner and attendant at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 十二年，出為伊犁領隊大臣，尋授寧夏副都統。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was sent out as commandant at Ili, and soon after appointed vice commander at Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was posted as commandant at Ili and soon after appointed vice commander at Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 召還，授鑲紅旗漢軍副都統。

translations.literal: Recalled to the capital, he was appointed vice commander of the Han Bordered Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled to court, he was appointed vice commander of the Han Bordered Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 十八年，命往河南剿教匪，將行，值匪犯禁城，急入捕賊，被優敘，命充領隊大臣，率火器營赴軍。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was ordered to Henan to suppress sect rebels; about to depart, when rebels breached the Forbidden City he rushed in to capture them, received exceptional commendation, was appointed commandant, and led the Firearms Battalion to the front.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he was ordered to Henan to suppress the sect rebels; just as he was about to leave, rebels broke into the Forbidden City, and he rushed in to capture them. For this he received exceptional commendation, was made commandant, and led the Firearms Battalion to the front.

sentences.zh: 迭敗賊於道口，進圍滑縣，敗援賊於城北，掘東門隧道，為賊覺，复踞西南隅，穴成火發，格布舍仍攻東門，以雲梯先登，獲賊目徐安國於地窖，擢御前侍衛，予騎都尉世職，遷正藍旗護軍統領。

translations.literal: He repeatedly defeated rebels at Daokou, advanced to besiege Huaxian, defeated relief rebels north of the city, dug a tunnel at the east gate, was discovered by the rebels, who again held the southwest corner; when the tunnel was finished fire broke out; Geburshe still attacked the east gate, was first to scale with cloud ladders, captured the rebel leader Xu Anguo in a cellar, was promoted to imperial bodyguard before the throne, granted the hereditary office of Riding Commander, and transferred to commander of the guards of the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He defeated the rebels again and again at Daokou, advanced to besiege Huaxian, and routed relief forces north of the city. A tunnel dug at the east gate was discovered; the rebels reoccupied the southwest corner, and when the tunnel was fired Geburshe still pressed the east gate, was first up the scaling ladders, and captured the rebel chieftain Xu Anguo in a cellar. He was promoted to imperial bodyguard, granted the hereditary office of Riding Commander, and made commander of the Plain Blue Banner guards.

sentences.zh: 坐失察部下私攜俘獲子女，議褫職，帝曰：「格布舍出兵時，聞警，由德勝門奔赴大內，朕不忍負之。

translations.literal: For failure to supervise subordinates who had privately taken captive women and children, removal from office was proposed. The emperor said: "When Geburshe was about to take the field and heard the alarm, he entered through Desheng Gate and raced to the inner palace—I cannot bring myself to fail him."
translations.idiomatic: Charged with failing to prevent his men from secretly taking captive women and children, he faced dismissal from office. The emperor said: "When Geburshe was about to march out and heard the alarm, he came through Desheng Gate straight to the inner palace—I cannot bring myself to fail him."

sentences.zh: 」改留任，予副都統銜、頭等侍衛，在大門行走。

translations.literal: His sentence was changed to retention in office; he was granted the brevet rank of vice commander and first-class bodyguard, serving at the great gate.
translations.idiomatic: Instead he was allowed to remain in office, granted the brevet rank of vice commander and first-class bodyguard, and assigned to duty at the great gate.

sentences.zh: 既而直乾清門，帝閱步射，中三矢，賞黃馬褂，擢寧夏將軍。

translations.literal: Soon after he was on duty at the Gate of Heavenly Purity; the emperor reviewed foot archery; he hit three arrows and was rewarded with a yellow jacket; he was promoted to general at Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, while on duty at the Gate of Heavenly Purity, he took part in the emperor's foot-archery review and hit three arrows; he was rewarded with a yellow jacket and promoted to general at Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 道光初，回疆軍事起，命駐哈密為聲援，調烏里雅蘇台將軍，移師守吐魯番。

translations.literal: At the start of Daoguang, when military affairs arose in the Muslim frontier, he was ordered to garrison Hami as support; he was transferred to general at Uliastai and then moved his army to hold Turfan.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Daoguang reign, when trouble broke out in the Muslim frontier, he was ordered to garrison Hami as a reserve force; he was then transferred to general at Uliastai and moved his troops to hold Turfan.

sentences.zh: 八年，召為正白旗蒙古都統，復出為寧夏將軍。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was recalled as commander of the Mongol Plain White Banner, then again sent out as general at Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was recalled as commander of the Mongol Plain White Banner, then sent out again as general at Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 十年，卒，諡昭武。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he died; posthumous title Zhaowu.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he died and was given the posthumous title Zhaowu.

sentences.zh: 子秀倫，襲騎都尉。

translations.literal: His son Xiulun inherited the office of Riding Commander.
translations.idiomatic: His son Xiulun inherited the Riding Commander office.

sentences.zh: 札克塔爾，張氏，滿洲正黃旗人，初金川土番也。

translations.literal: Zhaketaer, surname Zhang, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner, originally a Jinchuan tribesman.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaketaer, of the Zhang clan, was a Plain Yellow Banner Manchu originally from the Jinchuan tribes.

sentences.zh: 父為索諾木所殺。

translations.literal: His father was killed by Suonuomu.
translations.idiomatic: His father had been killed by Suonuomu.

sentences.zh: 年未二十，密獻入番路徑於將軍阿桂，隨徵，洊擢守備。

translations.literal: Before he was twenty, he secretly presented routes into the tribal territory to General Agui, followed the campaign, and was repeatedly promoted to garrison commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Before he was twenty he secretly gave General Agui the routes into tribal territory, joined the campaign, and rose by repeated promotions to garrison commandant.

sentences.zh: 高宗憐之，命隸內務府旗籍，擢二等侍衛、乾清門行走，兼正白旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: The Gaozong Emperor took pity on him, ordered him enrolled in the Household Department banner rolls, promoted him to second-class bodyguard and attendant at the Gate of Heavenly Purity, and concurrently vice commander of the Mongol Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: The Qianlong Emperor took pity on him, had him enrolled in the Household Department banner rolls, and promoted him to second-class bodyguard and attendant at the Gate of Heavenly Purity, while also making him vice commander of the Mongol Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年，從尚書那彥成赴陝軍，擊高天德、馬學禮於灰峪林，又擊川匪於龍草坪。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing he followed Minister Nayancheng to the Shaanxi army, attacked Gao Tiande and Ma Xueli at Huiyu Forest, and again attacked Sichuan rebels at Longcaoping.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Jiaqing he followed Minister Nayancheng to the Shaanxi front, struck Gao Tiande and Ma Xueli at Huiyu Forest, and then attacked Sichuan rebels at Longcaoping.

sentences.zh: 五年，偕綸布春夾擊白號賊於秦安龍山鎮，擒賊渠餘禮等，賜號瑚爾察巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, with Lunbuchun he attacked White Banner rebels from both sides at Longshan Town in Qin'an, captured the rebel chieftain Yu Li and others, and was granted the title Hurca Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he and Lunbuchun caught White Banner rebels in a pincer at Longshan Town in Qin'an, captured the chieftain Yu Li and others, and received the title Hurca Baturu.

sentences.zh: 又偕擊王廷詔、楊開甲於牛氾鎮，由山梁馳下，馬蹶，復起力戰，大破之，遷鑲白旗護軍統領。

translations.literal: Again with others he attacked Wang Tingzhao and Yang Kaijia at Niufan Town, galloped down from the mountain ridge, his horse stumbled, he rose and fought fiercely, routed them completely, and was transferred to commander of the guards of the Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He again joined an attack on Wang Tingzhao and Yang Kaijia at Niufan Town, charging down a mountain ridge; when his horse stumbled he remounted and fought on, breaking the enemy completely, and was made commander of the Bordered White Banner guards.

sentences.zh: 那彥成破張天倫於岷州林家鋪，轉戰鞏昌、文縣，賊據河岸，且擊且濟，逼賊郭家山，自中路仰攻，擒高天德子狗兒；

translations.literal: Nayancheng defeated Zhang Tianlun at Linjiapu in Minzhou, fought on through Gongchang and Wen County; the rebels held the riverbank, fighting even as they crossed; he pressed the rebels at Guojiashan, attacked upward from the center route, and captured Gao Tiande's son Gou'er;
translations.idiomatic: Nayancheng defeated Zhang Tianlun at Linjiapu in Minzhou and fought on through Gongchang and Wen County; the rebels held the riverbank, fighting even as they forded the stream; pressing them at Guojiashan, Zhaketaer attacked up the center route and captured Gao Tiande's son Gou'er;

sentences.zh: 又偕綸布春破伍金柱、楊開甲於分水嶺。

translations.literal: Again with Lunbuchun he defeated Wu Jinzhu and Yang Kaijia at Fenshui Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: With Lunbuchun he next defeated Wu Jinzhu and Yang Kaijia at Fenshui Ridge.

sentences.zh: 是年夏，召那彥成還京，札克塔爾留聽額勒登保節制。

translations.literal: That summer Nayancheng was recalled to the capital, and Zhaketaer remained under Eledengbao's command.
translations.idiomatic: That summer Nayancheng was recalled to the capital, and Zhaketaer stayed behind under Eledengbao's command.

sentences.zh: 每戰猛銳無前，軍中號曰「苗張」。

translations.literal: In every battle he was fierce and unstoppable, and in the army he was called "Miao Zhang."
translations.idiomatic: In battle he was ferocious and unstoppable, and the army nicknamed him "Miao Zhang."

sentences.zh: 楊開甲等竄湖北，間道邀擊於鄖西黃鶯鋪，擒斬千餘，予恩騎尉世職。

translations.literal: Yang Kaijia and others fled into Hubei; by a hidden route he intercepted them at Huangyingpu in Yunxi, captured and killed more than a thousand, and was granted the hereditary office of En Riding Captain.
translations.idiomatic: When Yang Kaijia and others fled into Hubei, he cut them off by a hidden route at Huangyingpu in Yunxi, killed more than a thousand, and received the hereditary office of En Riding Captain.

sentences.zh: 偕楊遇春破伍金柱於手扳崖、銅錢窖，殲楊開甲於茅坪。

translations.literal: With Yang Yuchun he defeated Wu Jinzhu at Shoubanya and Tongqianku and destroyed Yang Kaijia at Maoping.
translations.idiomatic: With Yang Yuchun he broke Wu Jinzhu at Shoubanya and Tongqianku and destroyed Yang Kaijia at Maoping.

sentences.zh: 詔以是​​役得其分擊之力，優予賚敘。

translations.literal: An edict stated that in this campaign his contribution in divided attacks had been essential, and he was exceptionally rewarded and commended.
translations.idiomatic: An edict held that his flanking attacks had been decisive in the campaign, and he received exceptional rewards and commendation.

sentences.zh: 諸賊循渭東竄，札克塔爾邀擊於寬灘，乃折趨棧道。

translations.literal: The rebels fled east along the Wei River; Zhaketaer intercepted them at Kuantan, and they then turned toward the plank road.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled east along the Wei; Zhaketaer intercepted them at Kuantan, forcing them to turn toward the plank road.

sentences.zh: 帝廑陝事急，趣其還軍，乃偕慶成駐褒城、西鄉，兼顧川、楚。

translations.literal: The emperor, anxious over the urgency of Shaanxi affairs, urged his return to the army; he then with Qingcheng garrisoned Baocheng and Xixiang, watching both Sichuan and Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: Anxious over the crisis in Shaanxi, the emperor urged him back to the front; he then joined Qingcheng in garrisoning Baocheng and Xixiang, covering both Sichuan and Huguang.

sentences.zh: 竄匪高天德、馬學禮窺渡漢，從額勒登保鈔截，屢敗之。

translations.literal: Fleeing rebels Gao Tiande and Ma Xueli sought to cross the Han River; following Eledengbao he cut them off and repeatedly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: When fleeing rebels Gao Tiande and Ma Xueli tried to cross the Han, he followed Eledengbao in cutting them off and defeated them again and again.

sentences.zh: 六年元旦，破賊五郎坪，躡伍懷志餘黨於瓦子溝，擒教首彭九皋，遇賊南鄭狼渡磏，躍馬衝賊為二，擒其渠王凌高。

translations.literal: On New Year's Day of the sixth year he defeated rebels at Wulangping, pursued Wu Huaizhi's remnant band at Wazigou, captured the sect leader Peng Jiugao, met rebels at Langduqian in Nanzheng, leaped on his horse and split the enemy in two, and captured their chieftain Wang Linggao.
translations.idiomatic: On New Year's Day of the sixth year he broke the rebels at Wulangping, ran down Wu Huaizhi's remnant band at Wazigou, and captured the sect leader Peng Jiugao; at Langduqian in Nanzheng he charged the enemy on horseback, cut them in two, and took their chieftain Wang Linggao.

sentences.zh: 夏，追冉學勝於棧東，夜襲黃安壩賊營，破之。

translations.literal: In summer he pursued Ran Xuesheng east of the plank road, raided the rebel camp at Huang'anba by night, and broke it.
translations.idiomatic: That summer he pursued Ran Xuesheng east of the plank road and broke the rebel camp at Huang'anba in a night attack.

sentences.zh: 偕楊遇春夾擊於天池山，突占山梁，擒其黨陳學文，追敗之竹谿、草鞋峽，賊竄陝。

translations.literal: With Yang Yuchun he attacked from both sides at Tianchi Mountain, suddenly seized the mountain ridge, captured the follower Chen Xuewen, pursued and defeated them at Zhuxi and Caoxiexia, and the rebels fled into Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: With Yang Yuchun he caught the enemy in a pincer at Tianchi Mountain, seized the ridge in a sudden rush, captured Chen Xuewen, pursued them through Zhuxi and Caoxiexia, and drove the rebels into Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 又偕遇春夾擊姚馨佐、曾芝秀於南唐嶺、劉家河口。

translations.literal: Again with Yuchun he attacked Yao Xinzu and Zeng Zhixiu from both sides at Nantangling and Liujiahekou.
translations.idiomatic: He again joined Yuchun in a pincer attack on Yao Xinzu and Zeng Zhixiu at Nantangling and Liujiahekou.

sentences.zh: 諸賊尋與學勝合，又敗之孫家坡、渭子池，與遇春同被褒賚。

translations.literal: The rebels soon joined Xuesheng; he again defeated them at Sunjiapo and Weizichi, and he and Yuchun were both praised and rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels soon joined Xuesheng, but he defeated them again at Sunjiapo and Weizichi; he and Yuchun were both praised and rewarded.

sentences.zh: 七年，從額勒登保追剿苟文明，賊匿太白山老林，了於山巔，軍至即遁。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he followed Eledengbao in pursuing Gou Wenming; the rebels hid in the old forest of Mount Taibai, keeping watch from the peaks, and fled as soon as the army arrived.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he followed Eledengbao in the pursuit of Gou Wenming; the rebels hid in the deep forest of Mount Taibai, posted lookouts on the peaks, and vanished whenever the army drew near.

sentences.zh: 札克塔爾以圍捕非計，撤辛峪口兵誘之，果出，晝夜追奔，扼其三面，偕楊遇春夾擊於鎮安石門溝，賊复竄老林，屢出屢入，詔斥曠日持久，褫職留任。

translations.literal: Zhaketaer judged encirclement impractical, withdrew troops from Xinyukou to lure them out, and when they emerged pursued day and night, blocked three sides, and with Yang Yuchun attacked from both sides at Shimen Gully in Zhen'an; the rebels again fled into the old forest, repeatedly emerging and re-entering; an edict rebuked the protracted delay, stripped him of office, and kept him on duty.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaketaer decided that a siege would not work, pulled troops back from Xinyukou to lure the rebels out, and when they appeared pursued them day and night, blocked three sides, and with Yang Yuchun caught them in a pincer at Shimen Gully in Zhen'an; the rebels slipped back into the old forest, coming out and vanishing again and again; an edict rebuked the long delay, stripped him of rank, and left him to serve on.

sentences.zh: 歷數月，獲文明妻子，始復之。

translations.literal: After several months he captured Wenming's wife and children, and only then was his rank restored.
translations.idiomatic: Several months later, after he captured Wenming's wife and children, his rank was restored.

sentences.zh: 八年，凱旋，充奏事處領班。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, upon triumphant return, he served as lead officer of the Memorial Office.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, after his triumphant return, he became lead officer of the Memorial Office.

sentences.zh: 扈駕回宮，入神武門，有男子陳德突犯禦輿，札克塔爾手擒之，封三等男爵。

translations.literal: Escorting the imperial return to the palace, as they entered Shenwu Gate a man named Chen De suddenly rushed the imperial carriage; Zhaketaer seized him with his own hands and was ennobled as a third-rank baron.
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the emperor back to the palace through Shenwu Gate, he seized with his own hands a man named Chen De who had suddenly rushed the imperial carriage, and was ennobled as a third-rank baron.

sentences.zh: 十一年，寧陝兵變，從德楞泰往剿，戰於方柴關，不利。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, when the Ningshan troops mutinied, he followed Delengtai to suppress them, fought at Fangchaiguan, and fared badly.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, when the Ningshan garrison mutinied, he followed Delengtai to suppress them; the battle at Fangchaiguan went badly.

sentences.zh: 既，叛兵就撫，德楞泰以震懾乞降奏。

translations.literal: Afterward the mutineers submitted to pacification, and Delengtai memorialized that they had surrendered from fear and intimidation.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward the mutineers accepted pacification, and Delengtai reported that they had surrendered under intimidation.

sentences.zh: 上召札克塔爾詢狀，斥其隱飾，褫職留男爵，回四川，以副將用。

translations.literal: The emperor summoned Zhaketaer to inquire into the situation, rebuked him for concealment, stripped him of office while retaining his barony, sent him back to Sichuan, and employed him as brigade general.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor summoned Zhaketaer to question him, rebuked him for covering up the facts, stripped him of office while keeping his barony, sent him back to Sichuan, and employed him as brigade general.

sentences.zh: 尋予副都統銜，充科布多參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Soon after he was granted the brevet rank of vice commander and appointed assistant resident at Kobdo.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he received the brevet rank of vice commander and was appointed assistant resident at Kobdo.

sentences.zh: 十三年，召還，授護軍統領，兼武備院卿。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was recalled, appointed commander of the guards, and concurrently director of the Armory.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was recalled, made commander of the guards, and concurrently director of the Armory.

sentences.zh: 十七年，卒，賜金治喪。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he died, and gold was granted for funeral arrangements.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he died, and the court granted gold for his funeral.

sentences.zh: 子常安，襲爵。

translations.literal: His son Chang'an inherited the title.
translations.idiomatic: His son Chang'an inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 桑吉斯塔爾，滿洲正黃旗人，亦四川土番。

translations.literal: Sangjisi, a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner, was also a Sichuan tribesman.
translations.idiomatic: Sangjisi, a Plain Yellow Banner Manchu, was likewise a Sichuan tribesman.

sentences.zh: 應募徵金川，歷石峰堡、廓爾喀之役，賜號察爾丹巴圖魯。

translations.literal: He answered the call to campaign in Jinchuan, served in the campaigns at Shifengbao and Gurkha, and was granted the title Ca'erdan Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: He volunteered for the Jinchuan campaign, fought at Shifengbao and in Nepal, and received the title Ca'erdan Baturu.

sentences.zh: 累擢頭等侍衛，改隸內務府滿洲。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to first-class bodyguard and transferred to the Manchu rolls of the Household Department.
translations.idiomatic: He rose by repeated promotions to first-class bodyguard and was transferred to the Household Department Manchu rolls.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年，與札克塔爾同赴陝軍，迭敗張漢潮於黃牛鋪、二郎壩、洵陽壩。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing he went with Zhaketaer to the Shaanxi army and repeatedly defeated Zhang Hanchao at Huangniupu, Erlangba, and Xunyangba.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Jiaqing he joined Zhaketaer on the Shaanxi front and defeated Zhang Hanchao again and again at Huangniupu, Erlangba, and Xunyangba.

sentences.zh: 迨漢潮就殲，加副都統銜，連擊教場壩、大壩、韭菜坪，並下之。

translations.literal: When Hanchao was destroyed, he was given the brevet rank of vice commander and in succession attacked Jiaochangba, Daba, and Jiucaiping, capturing them all.
translations.idiomatic: After Hanchao was destroyed he received the brevet rank of vice commander and in quick succession took Jiaochangba, Daba, and Jiucaiping.

sentences.zh: 五年，隴山鎮、林江鋪、郭家山諸戰，皆與札克塔爾俱，又殲劉允恭於陝境大中溪，敗伍金柱於鎮安手扳崖，被優敘。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, at the battles of Longshan Town, Linjiangpu, and Guojiashan, he fought together with Zhaketaer each time; he also destroyed Liu Yungong at Dazhongxi on the Shaanxi border and defeated Wu Jinzhu at Shoubanya in Zhen'an, and received exceptional commendation.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he fought alongside Zhaketaer at Longshan Town, Linjiangpu, and Guojiashan; he also destroyed Liu Yungong at Dazhongxi on the Shaanxi border and defeated Wu Jinzhu at Shoubanya in Zhen'an, earning exceptional commendation.

sentences.zh: 尋，金柱為楊遇春所殲，其餘黨西走，要其去路，躡追，自文縣、寧羌至龍安擊之，賊竄打箭爐寨，山徑險★C7，棄馬徒步，及於窄口子，痛殲之。

translations.literal: Soon after, Jinzhu was destroyed by Yang Yuchun; the remnant band fled west; he cut off their escape and pursued; from Wen County and Ningqiang to Long'an he struck them; the rebels fled to Dajianlu Stockade; the mountain paths were steep and perilous; abandoning their horses they went on foot; he caught them at Zhaikouzi and destroyed them utterly.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Wu Jinzhu was destroyed by Yang Yuchun, and Sangjisi cut off the fleeing remnant band and pursued them from Wen County and Ningqiang to Long'an. The rebels fled to Dajianlu Stockade over steep mountain paths, abandoned their horses, and went on foot; he caught them at Zhaikouzi and wiped them out.

sentences.zh: 分兵擊木蘭溝伏賊，僅存二百餘人，遁三岔河，與冉學勝合。

translations.literal: He divided his forces to attack ambush rebels at Mulan Gully; only a little over two hundred survived, fled to Sancha River, and joined Ran Xuesheng.
translations.idiomatic: He sent detachments against ambush rebels at Mulan Gully; only about two hundred survived, fled to Sancha River, and joined Ran Xuesheng.

sentences.zh: 詔斥遲留，額勒登保為疏辯，得白。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked the delay; Eledengbao memorialized in his defense, and he was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: An edict rebuked the delay, but Eledengbao memorialized in his defense and he was cleared.

sentences.zh: 六年，偕札克塔爾迭敗賊於狼渡磏、天池山、孫家坡。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, with Zhaketaer he repeatedly defeated rebels at Langduqian, Tianchi Mountain, and Sunjiapo.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he and Zhaketaer defeated the rebels again and again at Langduqian, Tianchi Mountain, and Sunjiapo.

sentences.zh: 賊自孫家坡敗竄，桑吉斯塔爾設伏楊柏坡以待，擒斬幾盡，高見奇就誅，被獎敘。

translations.literal: When the rebels fled in defeat from Sunjiapo, Sangjisi set an ambush at Yangbaipo to await them, captured and killed nearly all, Gao Jianqi was executed, and he received commendation and reward.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels fled in defeat from Sunjiapo, Sangjisi laid an ambush at Yangbaipo and killed nearly all of them; Gao Jianqi was executed, and Sangjisi received commendation and reward.

sentences.zh: 是冬，召回京。

translations.literal: That winter he was recalled to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he was recalled to the capital.

sentences.zh: 八年，偕札克塔爾捕陳德，予騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, with Zhaketaer he captured Chen De and was granted the hereditary office of Riding Commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he helped Zhaketaer capture Chen De and received the hereditary office of Riding Commander.

sentences.zh: 十一年，率巴圖魯侍衛赴寧陝剿叛兵。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he led Baturu bodyguards to Ningshan to suppress the mutinous troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he led Baturu bodyguards to Ningshan to suppress the mutineers.

sentences.zh: 及還，坐召對遲到，降頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: Upon his return, for arriving late at an imperial audience he was demoted to first-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he was demoted to first-class bodyguard for arriving late at an imperial audience.

sentences.zh: 尋授正藍旗漢軍副都統。

translations.literal: Soon after he was appointed vice commander of the Han Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was appointed vice commander of the Han Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 十八年，率火器營赴滑縣勦賊，以火攻，克城先登，复在御前行走。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he led the Firearms Battalion to Huaxian to suppress rebels, used fire attack, was first to scale the captured city, and again served before the imperial presence.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he led the Firearms Battalion to Huaxian to suppress the rebels, took the city by fire attack and was first over the wall, and again served in attendance before the throne.

sentences.zh: 坐軍中攜俘童當黜，原之；

translations.literal: For taking captive children while in the army he was liable to dismissal, but was pardoned;
translations.idiomatic: He was liable to dismissal for taking captive children while in the field, but was pardoned;

sentences.zh: 又坐事褫副都統，仍以頭等侍衛乾清門行走。

translations.literal: again, charged with an offense, he was stripped of the vice commandership and continued as first-class bodyguard at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: later, charged with another offense, he was stripped of the vice commandership and continued as first-class bodyguard at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，卒，賜金優恤。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he died, and gold was granted for generous condolence.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he died, and the court granted gold for a generous funeral allowance.

sentences.zh: 子策楞訥爾，三等侍衛，襲騎都尉，請葬父於近京，允之，賜葬貲焉。

translations.literal: His son Celengne'er, a third-class bodyguard, inherited the Riding Commander office, requested to bury his father near the capital, and this was granted with funeral funds bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: His son Celengne'er, a third-class bodyguard, inherited the Riding Commander office, asked to bury his father near the capital, and the request was granted with funeral funds.

sentences.zh: 馬瑜，甘肅張掖人。

translations.literal: Mayu was a native of Zhangye in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Mayu was a native of Zhangye in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 祖良柱，官四川松潘鎮總兵，遂寄籍華陽。

translations.literal: His grandfather Liangzhu served as general of Songpan garrison in Sichuan, and the family therefore registered domicile at Huayang.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Liangzhu had been general of the Songpan garrison in Sichuan, and the family therefore took registered domicile at Huayang.

sentences.zh: 瑜少以武生入伍，從征廓爾喀、苗疆，累遷游擊。

translations.literal: Yu in youth entered the army as a military licentiate, followed campaigns in Gurkha and the Miao frontier, and was repeatedly promoted to mobile corps commander.
translations.idiomatic: As a young military licentiate Mayu entered the army, served in Nepal and on the Miao frontier, and rose by repeated promotions to mobile corps commander.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，赴達州剿教匪，戰大園堡、安子坪，數有功，賜號達春巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing he went to Dazhou to suppress sect rebels, fought at Dayuanbao and Anziping with repeated merit, and was granted the title Dachun Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiaqing he went to Dazhou against the sect rebels, fought with distinction at Dayuanbao and Anziping, and received the title Dachun Baturu.

sentences.zh: 三年，從德楞泰殲齊王氏、姚之富於鄖西，​​瑜間諜功居多，擢參將。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed Delengtai in destroying Qi Wangshi and Yao Zhifu in Yunxi; Yu's contribution through reconnaissance and espionage was greatest, and he was promoted to colonel.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he followed Delengtai in destroying Qi Wangshi and Yao Zhifu in Yunxi; Mayu's intelligence work counted for most of the success, and he was promoted to colonel.

sentences.zh: 擊高均德於雒南鐵釘埡，賊奔就冉文儔，合踞大神山，諸軍合擊，瑜攻其東，克之。

translations.literal: He attacked Gao Junde at Tiedingya in Luonan; the rebels fled to join Ran Wenfu, together holding Dashen Mountain; the armies combined to attack, and Yu assaulted the east and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: He attacked Gao Junde at Tiedingya in Luonan; the rebels fled to join Ran Wenfu and together held Dashen Mountain; when the allied armies attacked, Mayu struck the east flank and took it.

sentences.zh: 及攻大鵬寨，瑜冒雨毀其南門。

translations.literal: When attacking Dapeng Stockade, Yu braved the rain and destroyed its south gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the assault on Dapeng Stockade he braved the rain and broke down the south gate.

sentences.zh: 四年春，文儔就擒，授四川督標副將。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year Wenfu was captured, and Yu was appointed deputy general of the Sichuan provincial command.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year, after Wenfu was captured, he was appointed deputy general of the Sichuan provincial command.

sentences.zh: 從德楞泰入楚，擒高均德，尋赴援陝、甘。

translations.literal: He followed Delengtai into Huguang, captured Gao Junde, and soon went to reinforce Shaanxi and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Delengtai into Huguang, captured Gao Junde, and soon marched to reinforce Shaanxi and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 五年春，復從德楞泰回川西，擊冉天元，戰江油新店子，進攻重華堰，深入火石埡，瑜分路助擊有功。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifth year he again followed Delengtai back to western Sichuan, attacked Ran Tianyuan, fought at Xindianzi in Jiangyou, advanced to attack Chonghuayan, penetrated deep to Huoshiya, and Yu divided forces to assist the attack with merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fifth year he again followed Delengtai back to western Sichuan against Ran Tianyuan, fought at Xindianzi in Jiangyou, advanced on Chonghuayan, and pushed deep to Huoshiya, where Mayu's detached columns helped win the day.

sentences.zh: 追賊石門寨、開封廟，至嘉陵江岸，迭敗之。

translations.literal: He pursued rebels to Shimen Stockade and Kaifeng Temple, to the bank of the Jialing River, and repeatedly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: He pursued the rebels through Shimen Stockade and Kaifeng Temple to the Jialing River and defeated them again and again.

sentences.zh: 又設伏敗藍號匪於七孔溪，克長池壩賊巢，擢貴州安義鎮總兵，調重慶鎮。

translations.literal: Again he set an ambush and defeated Blue Banner rebels at Qikongxi, captured the rebel nest at Changchiba, was promoted to general of Anyi garrison in Guizhou, and transferred to Chongqing garrison.
translations.idiomatic: He next ambushed and defeated Blue Banner rebels at Qikongxi, took the rebel stronghold at Changchiba, was promoted to general of the Anyi garrison in Guizhou, and transferred to the Chongqing garrison.

sentences.zh: 瑜祖故溫福部將，勒保與有舊，甚倚之，又久從德楞泰為翼長，軍事多所贊畫。

translations.literal: Yu's grandfather had been a subordinate of Wenfu; Lebao was old friends with the family and relied on him greatly; he had also long followed Delengtai as wing commander and contributed much to military planning.
translations.idiomatic: Mayu's grandfather had served under Wenfu; Lebao was an old family friend and leaned heavily on him; he had also long served Delengtai as wing commander and helped plan many campaigns.

sentences.zh: 八月，白號庹向瑤竄長壩，將渡河，瑜率步騎掩至，蹙之，向瑤赴水逸。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the White Banner rebel Tuo Xiangyao fled to Changba and was about to cross the river; Yu led infantry and cavalry in a surprise approach, pressed him hard, and Xiangyao escaped by throwing himself into the water.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the White Banner rebel Tuo Xiangyao fled to Changba and was about to cross the river; Mayu swept in with infantry and cavalry, cornered him, and Xiangyao escaped only by throwing himself into the water.

sentences.zh: 六年春，徐天德自洵陽北竄，留後隊於峪河口，前隊奪渡漢江，追及乾溝，擒斬千餘，賊奔鎮安，雪夜間道出野豬坪要之。

translations.literal: In the spring of the sixth year Xu Tiande fled north from Xunyang, left the rear column at Yuhekou, the vanguard seized a crossing of the Han River, pursued to Qiangou, captured and killed more than a thousand; the rebels fled to Zhen'an, and on a snowy night he took a hidden route to intercept them at Yezhuping.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the sixth year Xu Tiande fled north from Xunyang, leaving his rear guard at Yuhekou while the vanguard forced a crossing of the Han and pursued to Qiangou, killing more than a thousand; when the rebels fled toward Zhen'an, Mayu cut them off by a hidden route on a snowy night at Yezhuping.

sentences.zh: 時龍紹週分黨入太平老林，自率大隊赴楚，欲與天德合，蹙之竹山官渡河，夜聞追騎聲，爭赴水，漂溺泰半。

translations.literal: At that time Long Shaozhou split off a party into the old forest at Taiping and himself led the main force toward Huguang to join Tiande; he pressed them at Guandu River in Zhushan; at night, hearing the sound of pursuing cavalry, they rushed into the water, and more than half drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Long Shaozhou had meanwhile sent a detachment into the old forest at Taiping and led the main body toward Huguang to join Tiande; Mayu cornered them at Guandu River in Zhushan, and at night, hearing the pursuing cavalry, the rebels rushed into the river and more than half drowned.

sentences.zh: 夏，從德楞泰追天德，破之黃石坂，進逼毗河鋪，賊勢瓦解，天德竄死河灘。

translations.literal: In summer he followed Delengtai in pursuing Tiande, defeated him at Huangshiban, advanced to press Pihepu, the rebel force collapsed, and Tiande fled and died on the river flats.
translations.idiomatic: That summer he followed Delengtai in pursuit of Tiande, broke him at Huangshiban, pressed on to Pihepu until the rebel force collapsed, and Tiande fled to his death on the river flats.

sentences.zh: 遂偕賽衝阿等追紹週入川，戰菜子埡、雲霧溪，皆捷，賊西趨陝。

translations.literal: He then with Sai Chong'a and others pursued Shaozhou into Sichuan, fought at Caiziya and Yunwuxi with victory each time, and the rebels fled west toward Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined Sai Chong'a and others in pursuing Shaozhou into Sichuan, winning victories at Caiziya and Yunwuxi before the rebels fled west toward Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 冬，殲紹週於平利岳家坪，於是黃號略盡。

translations.literal: In winter he destroyed Shaozhou at Yuejiaping in Pingli, and with that the Yellow Banner rebels were largely exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he destroyed Shaozhou at Yuejiaping in Pingli, and with that the Yellow Banner rebels were nearly wiped out.

sentences.zh: 又敗賊於通江劉家壩，俘獲甚眾。

translations.literal: Again he defeated rebels at Liujiaba in Tongjiang, capturing a great many.
translations.idiomatic: He again defeated the rebels at Liujiaba in Tongjiang and took a great many captives.

sentences.zh: 七年春，師次巫山十二峰，檢捕線號殘匪。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, that spring, the army halted at the Twelve Peaks of Wushan and searched out remnant bandits of the Xian Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, that spring, the army encamped at the Twelve Peaks of Wushan and hunted down remnant rebels of the Xian Banner.

sentences.zh: 夏，擊樊人傑等於東湖雞公山梁，又敗蒲景於大埡口，人傑走死。

translations.literal: In summer he attacked Fan Renjie and others on the Jigongshan ridge east of Donghu Lake, again defeated Pu Tianbao at Dayakou, and Renjie fled to his death.
translations.idiomatic: In summer he attacked Fan Renjie and others on the Jigongshan ridge east of Donghu Lake, then defeated Pu Tianbao at Dayakou; Renjie fled and met his death.

sentences.zh: 冬，追賊老山施家溝，山徑險★C7，徒步而入，擒其渠趙鑑，殲餘匪於中子洋。

translations.literal: In winter he pursued bandits to Shijiagou in the Laoshan hills; the mountain paths were steep and treacherous, so he entered on foot, captured the ringleader Zhao Jian, and exterminated the remaining bandits at Zhongziyang.
translations.idiomatic: In winter he pursued rebels into Shijiagou in the Laoshan hills along steep and dangerously narrow mountain tracks, went in on foot, captured the ringleader Zhao Jian, and wiped out the survivors at Zhongziyang.

sentences.zh: 偵巴、巫界上有匿匪，月夜搗其巢，悉殲之，被獎賚。

translations.literal: Scouts reported bandits hiding on the Ba-Wu border; under a moonlit night he raided their nest, exterminated them all, and was rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: Intelligence reported bandits concealed on the Ba-Wu border; he stormed their lair by moonlight, killed them to the last man, and received a reward.

sentences.zh: 時賊勢窮蹙，瑜自巫山嚮北搜剿。

translations.literal: At that time the rebel force was cornered, and Yu marched north from Wushan to search and suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: By then the rebels were at their wit's end; Mayu marched north from Wushan to hunt them down.

sentences.zh: 八年，擒王三魁於馬家壩，三槐之弟也。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he captured Wang Sankui at Majiaba—Wang Sanhuai's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he captured Wang Sankui at Majiaba, Wang Sanhuai's younger brother.

sentences.zh: 會楚匪复逼入川，偕色爾滾破之鐙盞窩，餘匪殆盡。

translations.literal: When Huguang bandits again pressed into Sichuan, he with Se'ergun broke them at Dengzhanwo, and the remnant bandits were nearly all gone.
translations.idiomatic: When Huguang rebels again pressed into Sichuan, he and Se'ergun crushed them at Dengzhanwo and nearly wiped out the survivors.

sentences.zh: 三省設防，瑜駐川界徐家壩，擊陝境逸匪，殲之。

translations.literal: The three provinces set up defensive lines; Yu garrisoned Xujiaba on the Sichuan border, struck fugitive bandits on the Shaanxi frontier, and destroyed them.
translations.idiomatic: The three provinces established defensive lines; Mayu held Xujiaba on the Sichuan frontier, struck fugitive rebels on the Shaanxi border, and destroyed them.

sentences.zh: 九年，擢江南提督，調雲南，皆未之任，留辦善後。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was promoted to governor-general of Jiangnan and transferred to Yunnan, but took neither post and remained to handle the aftermath.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was promoted to governor-general of Jiangnan and transferred to Yunnan, yet assumed neither office and stayed on to manage the aftermath.

sentences.zh: 殲湖北竄匪苟文華等，被優賚。

translations.literal: He exterminated Gou Wenhua and other bandits who had fled into Hubei and received special rewards.
translations.idiomatic: He destroyed Gou Wenhua and other rebels who had fled into Hubei and was richly rewarded.

sentences.zh: 尋坐添紫城疏防，奪巴圖魯、花翎。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was impeached for negligent defense at Tianzicheng and stripped of his Batulu title and peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was censured for lax defense at Tianzicheng and stripped of his Batulu title and peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 率兵二千入老林追賊，攻克鳳凰寨，擒斬數百。

translations.literal: He led two thousand troops into the old forest in pursuit, stormed Fenghuang Stockade, and captured or killed several hundred.
translations.idiomatic: He led two thousand men into the old forest in pursuit, stormed Fenghuang Stockade, and captured or killed several hundred.

sentences.zh: 既而苟文潤就殲，复花翎、勇號。

translations.literal: When Gou Wenrun was at last destroyed, his peacock feather and brave title were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Once Gou Wenrun was finally destroyed, his peacock feather and honorary military title were restored.

sentences.zh: 十年，赴本官，歷江南、直隸提督。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he took up his regular appointment and served successively as governor-general of Jiangnan and Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he assumed his regular post and served in turn as governor-general of Jiangnan and Zhili.

sentences.zh: 十八年，從車駕幸熱河，校射，中三矢，賜黃馬褂。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he accompanied the imperial procession to Rehe, competed at archery, hit with three arrows, and was granted a yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he accompanied the emperor to Rehe, competed at archery, scored three hits, and was granted a yellow riding jacket.

sentences.zh: 其秋，滑縣賊起，命偕總督溫承惠進剿，破南湖、北湖賊，進擊道口。

translations.literal: That autumn rebels rose in Huaxian; he was ordered to join Governor-general Wen Chenghui in suppressing them, broke the South Lake and North Lake rebel camps, and advanced against Daokou.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn rebels rose in Huaxian; he was ordered to join Governor-general Wen Chenghui in suppressing them, broke the rebel camps at South Lake and North Lake, and advanced on Daokou.

sentences.zh: 尋赴開州搜捕，毀潘章、李家莊、袁家莊諸賊巢。

translations.literal: He then went to Kaizhou to hunt bandits and destroyed bandit nests at Panzhang, Lijiazhuang, Yuanjiazhuang, and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: He then went to Kaizhou to hunt rebels and destroyed bandit lairs at Panzhang, Lijiazhuang, Yuanjiazhuang, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 事平，優敘。

translations.literal: When the campaign was over, he received exceptional commendation.
translations.idiomatic: When the campaign ended, he received exceptional commendation.

sentences.zh: 十九年，調江南。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, transferred to Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he was transferred to Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 坐事左遷徐州鎮總兵，調兗州鎮。

translations.literal: Impeached, demoted to Xuzhou garrison commander, transferred to Yanzhou garrison.
translations.idiomatic: After an impeachment he was demoted to commander of the Xuzhou garrison and transferred to the Yanzhou garrison.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，復任江南提督。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, again appointed Jiangnan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year he was reappointed governor-general of Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 未幾，卒，以前勞優恤，諡壯勤。

translations.literal: Before long he died; for his long service he received exceptional posthumous honors, and was given the posthumous name Zhuangqin.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he died; for his long service he received exceptional posthumous honors and was given the posthumous name Zhuangqin.

sentences.zh: 蒲尚佐，四川松潘人。

translations.literal: Pushangzuo, a native of Songpan, Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Pushangzuo was a native of Songpan in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 由行伍拔補千總，從征苗疆，累擢游擊。

translations.literal: From the ranks selected and appointed company captain; followed campaigns in the Miao territories; repeatedly promoted to battalion commander.
translations.idiomatic: Raised from the ranks to company captain, he campaigned in the Miao territories and rose by stages to battalion commander.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶三年，從德楞泰殲齊王氏、姚之富於鄖西，​​賜號勁勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jiaqing, following Delengtai, destroyed Qi Wangshi and Yao Zhifu at Yunxi; granted the title Brave Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jiaqing he followed Delengtai in destroying Qi Wangshi and Yao Zhifu at Yunxi and was granted the title Brave Batulu.

sentences.zh: 克箕山有功，擢參將。

translations.literal: For merit in capturing Jishan, promoted to colonel.
translations.idiomatic: For merit in taking Jishan he was promoted to colonel.

sentences.zh: 五年，偕馬瑜合擊藍號賊於陡坎子山，大破之，擢四川維州協副將。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, with Mayu jointly attacked Blue Banner rebels at Doukanzishan, broke them decisively; promoted to deputy commander of the Weizhou Brigade in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, joining Mayu, he jointly attacked Blue Banner rebels at Doukanzishan and broke them decisively; he was promoted to deputy commander of the Weizhou Brigade in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 圍趙麻花於石虎林，賊夜突圍者三，皆擊卻，次日盡殲焉，被獎敘。

translations.literal: Besieged Zhao Mahua at Shihulin; rebels broke out by night three times, all repelled; the next day all were exterminated; rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: He besieged Zhao Mahua at Shihulin; the rebels broke out by night three times and were repelled each time, and the next day they were wiped out; he was commended.

sentences.zh: 六年，從德楞泰破高天升於洵陽江岸，追至二峪河，雪夜出山徑進攻，天升就誅，擢雲南鶴麗鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, following Delengtai, broke Gao Tiansheng at the Xunyang riverbank, pursued to the Eryu River; on a snowy night emerged from mountain paths to attack; Tiansheng was executed; promoted to commander of the Heli garrison in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he followed Delengtai in defeating Gao Tiansheng on the Xunyang riverbank, pursued him to the Eryu River, and on a snowy night advanced through mountain trails to attack; Tiansheng was killed, and Pushangzuo was promoted to commander of the Heli garrison in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 敗龍紹週於茅壩，迭敗徐天德於廟坪、黃石坂，又追擊於川、陝境上。

translations.literal: Defeated Long Shaozhou at Maoba; repeatedly defeated Xu Tiande at Miaoping and Huangshiban; again pursued and attacked on the Sichuan-Shaanxi border.
translations.idiomatic: He defeated Long Shaozhou at Maoba, beat Xu Tiande in succession at Miaoping and Huangshiban, and pursued them along the Sichuan-Shaanxi border.

sentences.zh: 每戰輒殪數百，遂躡入楚，沿路搜剿，及紹週為賽衝阿等所殲，其餘黨竄竹山，圍剿殲戮無遺。

translations.literal: Each battle killed several hundred; then pressed into Huguang, searching and suppressing along the route; when Shaozhou was destroyed by Sai Chong'a and others, the remaining followers fled to Zhushan; besieged and exterminated without remnant.
translations.idiomatic: In battle after battle he killed hundreds; he then pressed into Huguang, scouring the route. After Shaozhou was destroyed by Sai Chong'a and others, the rest fled into Zhushan, where Pushangzuo besieged and slaughtered them to the last man.

sentences.zh: 七年，從德楞泰轉戰川、楚，諜知樊人傑屯杉木嶺，蒲天寶屯代峰，別有賊屯雞公山為聲援，先破之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, following Delengtai fighting across Sichuan and Huguang, learned Fan Renjie garrisoned Shanmuling, Pu Tianbao garrisoned Daifeng, and separately bandits garrisoned Jigongshan as reinforcement; first broke the latter.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, campaigning with Delengtai across Sichuan and Huguang, he learned that Fan Renjie held Shanmuling, Pu Tianbao held Daifeng, and another rebel force garrisoned Jigongshan as reinforcement; he struck the last first.

sentences.zh: 人傑走霧露河，尚佐迎擊，轉戰七晝夜，斬獲無算。

translations.literal: Renjie fled to the Wululu River; Pushangzuo intercepted and fought; battled seven days and nights; beheaded and captured without count.
translations.idiomatic: Renjie fled toward the Wululu River; Pushangzuo intercepted him and fought for seven days and nights, taking countless heads and captives.

sentences.zh: 天寶走當陽，偕色爾滾偵踪追擊，賊收殘眾屯興山桂連坪，襲破之。

translations.literal: Tianbao fled to Dangyang; with Se'ergun tracked and pursued; rebels gathered remnant forces at Guilianping in Xingshan; raided and broke them.
translations.idiomatic: Tianbao fled toward Dangyang; with Se'ergun, Pushangzuo tracked and pursued him. The rebels rallied their survivors at Guilianping in Xingshan, and he stormed and broke them.

sentences.zh: 賊走踞鮑家山，德楞泰衝其前，尚佐等攀危崖，繞出賊巢上，痛殲之，餘賊狂奔出山，僅數百人，竄入老林。

translations.literal: Rebels fled to hold Baojiashan; Delengtai charged their front; Pushangzuo and others climbed perilous cliffs, circled above the rebel nest, and savagely exterminated them; remnant rebels fled wildly from the mountain, only several hundred, fled into the old forest.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels retreated to Baojiashan; Delengtai struck them from the front while Pushangzuo and others scaled perilous cliffs to come in above the rebel stronghold and cut them down. A few hundred survivors bolted from the hills and fled into the old forest.

sentences.zh: 天寶被追急，墜崖死，被優賚，兼乾清門侍衛。

translations.literal: Tianbao, hard pressed in pursuit, fell from a cliff and died; splendidly rewarded; also made Qianqing Gate bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: Pu Tianbao, hard pressed, fell from a cliff and died; Pushangzuo was richly rewarded and also made a bodyguard of the Qianqing Gate.

sentences.zh: 又偕副都統富僧德殲戴仕傑於興山，擒崔連樂、崔宗和於房縣，斬陳仕學於巴東。

translations.literal: Again with Deputy Commander Fu Sengde destroyed Dai Shijie at Xingshan; captured Cui Lianle and Cui Zonghe at Fang County; beheaded Chen Shixue at Badong.
translations.idiomatic: With Deputy Commander Fu Sengde he destroyed Dai Shijie at Xingshan, captured Cui Lianle and Cui Zonghe in Fang County, and beheaded Chen Shixue in Badong.

sentences.zh: 八年，青號劉渣鬍子與黃號陳大貴踞老鴉寨，尚佐乘霧雨襲之，賊棄寨循當陽河走，遇富僧德伏兵，爭赴水死，擒大貴。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Green Banner Liu Zhahuzi and Yellow Banner Chen Dagui held Laoyazhai; Pushangzuo seized fog and rain to raid; rebels abandoned the stockade and fled along the Dangyang River; met Fu Sengde's ambush; rushed into the water to die; captured Dagui.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the Green Banner chief Liu Zhahuzi and the Yellow Banner chief Chen Dagui held Laoyazhai; Pushangzuo attacked in fog and rain. The rebels abandoned the stockade and fled along the Dangyang River, ran into Fu Sengde's ambush, and many drowned themselves; Chen Dagui was captured.

sentences.zh: 駐巫山，搜捕餘匪，賊氛遂淨。

translations.literal: Garrisoned Wushan, searched and captured remnant bandits; rebel atmosphere thus cleared.
translations.idiomatic: He garrisoned Wushan, hunted down the remnants, and the rebellion in the region was finally subdued.

sentences.zh: 十三年，擢湖南提督，調甘肅。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, promoted to Hunan governor-general; transferred to Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was promoted to governor-general of Hunan and transferred to Gansu.

sentences.zh: 二十年，以病解職，歸，卒。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, due to illness resigned office; returned home; died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he resigned on grounds of illness, returned home, and died.

sentences.zh: 薛大烈，甘肅皋蘭人。

translations.literal: Xue Dalie, a native of Gaolan, Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Dalie was a native of Gaolan in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 由行伍從征台灣、廓爾喀，累遷都司。

translations.literal: From the ranks followed campaigns in Taiwan and Gurkha; repeatedly promoted to battalion adjutant.
translations.idiomatic: From the ranks he campaigned in Taiwan and Gurkha, rising by stages to battalion adjutant.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年，從總督宜綿剿教匪，由陝入川，數有功，擢游擊。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiaqing, following Governor Yimian suppressed sect bandits; from Shaanxi entered Sichuan; several merits; promoted to battalion commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jiaqing he followed Governor Yimian against the sect rebels, marching from Shaanxi into Sichuan with repeated merit, and was promoted to battalion commander.

sentences.zh: 三年，迭克賊於白沙河、蘭場。

translations.literal: In the third year, repeatedly overcame rebels at Baisha River and Lanchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he repeatedly defeated rebels at the Baisha River and Lanchang.

sentences.zh: 時王三槐踞東鄉安樂坪，勒保令劉清招降。

translations.literal: At that time Wang Sanhuai held Dongxiang Anleping; Lebao ordered Liu Qing to summon surrender.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Wang Sanhuai held Anleping in Dongxiang; Lebao ordered Liu Qing to negotiate his surrender.

sentences.zh: 清遣劉星渠偕二武員往，留為質。

translations.literal: Qing sent Liu Xingqu with two martial officers; left as hostages.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Qing sent Liu Xingqu with two martial officers; they were left behind as hostages.

sentences.zh: 三槐偕至大營，星渠密請擒之。

translations.literal: Sanhuai accompanied them to the great camp; Xingqu secretly requested to capture him.
translations.idiomatic: Sanhuai came with them to the main camp, and Xingqu secretly asked permission to seize him.

sentences.zh: 大烈爭曰：「舍守備、千總二員易一賊，褻國體，失軍心。

translations.literal: Xue Dalie objected, saying: "To give up two officers—a garrison commandant and a company captain—in exchange for one rebel would demean the nation's dignity and lose the army's heart.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Dalie objected: "To trade two officers—a garrison commandant and a company captain—for a single rebel would disgrace the state and destroy the troops' confidence.

sentences.zh: 」乃止。

translations.literal: " Thereupon they stopped.
translations.idiomatic: " The plan was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 越數日，三槐復自來，遂羈留，而以陣擒上聞，勒保受上賞，大烈亦賜號健勇巴圖魯，擢參將。

translations.literal: After several days Sanhuai again came of himself; then detained; yet reported as captured in battle to the throne; Lebao received high reward; Dalie also granted the title Vigorous Batulu; promoted to colonel.
translations.idiomatic: Several days later Wang Sanhuai came again of his own accord and was detained—but the report to court claimed he had been taken in battle; Lebao received a high reward, and Xue Dalie was also granted the title Vigorous Batulu and promoted to colonel.

sentences.zh: 未幾，擢四川提標副將，充翼長。

translations.literal: Before long, promoted to Sichuan command deputy general; served as wing commander.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was promoted to deputy commander of the Sichuan command and made a wing commander.

sentences.zh: 善伺勒保意，預諸將黜陟，軍中屬目焉。

translations.literal: Skilled at reading Lebao's intent; foreknew generals' promotions and dismissals; in the army all eyes were on him.
translations.idiomatic: He was adept at reading Lebao's mind and anticipating the promotions and dismissals of other commanders; the whole army watched him.

sentences.zh: 五年，擢川北鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, promoted to Chuanbei garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was promoted to commander of the Chuanbei garrison.

sentences.zh: 勒保以罪逮，魁倫代之，諸將不用命，賊益猖，遂連渡嘉陵江、潼河，大烈偕阿哈保等御之。

translations.literal: Lebao arrested on charges; Kuilun replaced him; generals did not obey orders; rebels grew more rampant; then crossed the Jialing and Tong Rivers in succession; Dalie with Ahabao and others defended against them.
translations.idiomatic: Lebao was arrested on charges; Kuilun replaced him. The generals would not obey, and the rebels grew bolder, crossing the Jialing and Tong Rivers in succession; Xue Dalie with Ahabao and others held them off.

sentences.zh: 尋復起勒保督師，從勦賊於保寧。

translations.literal: Soon Lebao restored to command the army; followed in suppressing rebels at Baoning.
translations.idiomatic: Lebao was soon restored to command; Xue Dalie followed him in suppressing rebels at Baoning.

sentences.zh: 別賊自開封廟截大軍後路，大烈擊卻之。

translations.literal: Separate rebels from Kaifeng Temple cut off the main army's rear route; Dalie repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: Another rebel force from Kaifeng Temple tried to cut the army's rear; Xue Dalie drove them back.

sentences.zh: 偕阿哈保扼嘉陵江，賊不得渡，被獎敘。

translations.literal: With Ahabao held the Jialing River; rebels could not cross; rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: With Ahabao he blocked the Jialing River so the rebels could not cross, and was commended.

sentences.zh: 夏，連敗白號賊於龍安鐵籠堡、竹子山，遂從勒保擊苟文明，解高寺寨圍。

translations.literal: In summer, repeatedly defeated White Banner rebels at Tielongbao and Zhuzishan in Long'an; then followed Lebao to attack Gou Wenming; relieved the siege of Gaosi Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: That summer he repeatedly defeated White Banner rebels at Tielongbao and Zhuzishan in Long'an, then followed Lebao against Gou Wenming and lifted the siege of Gaosi Stockade.

sentences.zh: 追賊循嘉陵江至石板坨，德楞泰躡其後，勒保繞其前，賊分遁。

translations.literal: Pursued rebels along the Jialing to Shibantuo; Delengtai followed their rear; Lebao circled their front; rebels split and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing the rebels along the Jialing to Shibantuo, with Delengtai on their heels and Lebao blocking ahead, the rebels scattered and fled.

sentences.zh: 大烈掩擊餘匪於飛龍場，盡殲之。

translations.literal: Dalie ambush-attacked remnant bandits at Feilongchang; all exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Dalie ambushed the survivors at Feilongchang and wiped them out.

sentences.zh: 九月，敗賊下八廟，進扼倒流水。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, defeated rebels below Bamiao; advanced to hold Daoliushui.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he defeated rebels below Bamiao and advanced to hold Daoliushui.

sentences.zh: 會賽衝阿、溫春兵至，夾擊，大破之，殲湯思舉。

translations.literal: When Sai Chong'a and Wenchun's troops arrived, attacked from both sides, broke them decisively; destroyed Tang Siju.
translations.idiomatic: Sai Chong'a and Wenchun arrived with their troops; in a joint attack they broke the enemy and killed Tang Siju.

sentences.zh: 冬，偕阿哈保破楊開第於渠縣安仁溪，追奔百餘裡，至巴州兩台山，擒斬二千餘。

translations.literal: In winter, with Ahabao broke Yang Kaidi at Anren Stream in Quxian; pursued the rout more than a hundred li to Liangtaishan in Bazhou; captured and beheaded more than two thousand.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, with Ahabao, he broke Yang Kaidi at Anren Stream in Quxian and pursued more than a hundred li to Liangtaishan in Bazhou, capturing and killing more than two thousand.

sentences.zh: 開第逸入營山柏林場，亂矛斃之。

translations.literal: Kaidi escaped into Bolinchang in Yingshan; killed by a chaos of spears.
translations.idiomatic: Kaidi escaped into Bolinchang in Yingshan and was killed by a volley of spears.

sentences.zh: 六年春，剿楊步青於大寧金竹坪，乘雪進擊，連敗之白馬廟、大蓋頂。

translations.literal: In the spring of the sixth year, suppressed Yang Buqing at Jinzhuping in Daning; seized the snow to advance and attack; repeatedly defeated him at Baimamiao and Dagaoding.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the sixth year he suppressed Yang Buqing at Jinzhuping in Daning, advanced through the snow, and defeated him in succession at Baimamiao and Dagaoding.

sentences.zh: 樊人傑、徐萬富屯儀隴碑寺寨，偕阿哈保夜襲之，殲萬富，賊奔​​川東，追及之，人傑跳崖遁，散竄老林。

translations.literal: Fan Renjie and Xu Wanfu garrisoned Beisi Stockade in Yilong; with Ahabao night-raided; destroyed Wanfu; rebels fled to eastern Sichuan; pursued and caught up; Renjie leaped from a cliff and escaped; scattered and fled into the old forest.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Renjie and Xu Wanfu held Beisi Stockade in Yilong; with Ahabao he raided by night, killed Wanfu, and pursued the fleeing rebels into eastern Sichuan. Renjie leaped from a cliff and escaped, and the rest scattered into the old forest.

sentences.zh: 大烈進剿楊開第、張漢潮餘黨，拔九杵寨，追擊於沙箕灣，擒賊目李尊賢。

translations.literal: Dalie advanced to suppress Yang Kaidi and Zhang Hanchao's remnant followers; took Jiuchu Stockade; pursued and attacked at Shaqi Bay; captured rebel chief Li Zunxian.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Dalie pressed the remnants of Yang Kaidi and Zhang Hanchao, stormed Jiuchu Stockade, pursued them to Shaqi Bay, and captured the rebel chief Li Zunxian.

sentences.zh: 藍號曹世倫竄南江九嶺子，偕田朝貴合擊殲之。

translations.literal: Blue Banner Cao Shilun fled to Jiulingzi in Nanjiang; with Tian Chaogui jointly attacked and destroyed him.
translations.idiomatic: The Blue Banner rebel Cao Shilun fled to Jiulingzi in Nanjiang; with Tian Chaogui, Xue Dalie attacked and destroyed him.

sentences.zh: 夏，青、藍兩號賊竄東鄉，犯仁和、永興二寨，師分三路入，大烈由右，蹙之華尖壩河濱，殲苟文通、鮮俸先，又擊賊巴州石鐍山，遣兵伏龍鳳埡，自與阿哈保奮擊，擒賊渠徐天壽、王登高等，詔獎賚，授其子千總。

translations.literal: In summer, Green and Blue Banner rebels fled to Dongxiang; attacked Renhe and Yongxing stockades; the army divided three routes to enter; Dalie on the right; drove them to the Huajianba riverbank; destroyed Gou Wentong and Xian Fengxian; again attacked rebels at Shijueshan in Bazhou; sent troops to ambush at Longfeng Pass; himself with Ahabao fought fiercely; captured rebel chiefs Xu Tianshou and Wang Denggao and others; edict rewarded; his son granted company captain.
translations.idiomatic: That summer Green and Blue Banner rebels fled into Dongxiang and attacked Renhe and Yongxing stockades. The army entered in three columns; Xue Dalie took the right, drove the enemy to the banks of the Huajianba River, and destroyed Gou Wentong and Xian Fengxian. He again struck rebels at Shijueshan in Bazhou, sent troops in ambush at Longfeng Pass, and with Ahabao led a fierce assault that captured the rebel chiefs Xu Tianshou and Wang Denggao and others; an edict commended him and his son was made a company captain.

sentences.zh: 白號高見奇、魏學盛合竄棧道，大烈要之於大茅坪山半，偕阿哈保夾擊，勒保督諸將自山頂下壓，賊大潰。

translations.literal: White Banner Gao Jianqi and Wei Xuesheng jointly fled along the plank road; Dalie intercepted them halfway up Damaping Mountain; with Ahabao attacked from both sides; Lebao directed the generals down from the mountaintop; rebels greatly routed.
translations.idiomatic: The White Banner chiefs Gao Jianqi and Wei Xuesheng fled together along the plank road; Xue Dalie blocked them halfway up Damaping Mountain, and with Ahabao caught them in a pincer while Lebao drove the generals down from the summit; the rebels collapsed.

sentences.zh: 見奇竄空山壩，與冉學勝合，屯南江盧家灣，乘不備擊之，擒學勝，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: Jianqi fled to Kongshanba and joined Ran Xuesheng; garrisoned Lujiawan in Nanjiang; seized them unprepared and attacked; captured Xuesheng; granted hereditary Cloud Riding Captain.
translations.idiomatic: Jianqi fled to Kongshanba and joined Ran Xuesheng; they garrisoned Lujiawan in Nanjiang. Xue Dalie caught them off guard, captured Ran Xuesheng, and was granted the hereditary rank of Cloud Riding Captain.

sentences.zh: 冬，敗白號賊於達州盧硐寺，又追敗之開縣，擒黎朝順，賊竄西鄉漁渡壩。

translations.literal: In winter, defeated White Banner rebels at Ludong Temple in Dazhou; again pursued and defeated them at Kaixian; captured Li Chaoshun; rebels fled to Yuduba in Xixiang.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he defeated White Banner rebels at Ludong Temple in Dazhou, pursued and beat them again in Kaixian, captured Li Chaoshun, and drove the rest toward Yuduba in Xixiang.

sentences.zh: 大烈裹糧追躡，由陝入川，敗之於通江羅村，复偕羅聲皋等尾擊之。

translations.literal: Dalie carried rations in pursuit; from Shaanxi entered Sichuan; defeated them at Luocun in Tongjiang; again with Luo Shenggao and others tail-attacked.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Dalie marched with carried grain in pursuit, crossed from Shaanxi into Sichuan, defeated them at Luocun in Tongjiang, and again with Luo Shenggao and others harried them from the rear.

sentences.zh: 師次八台山，別賊圍趙家坪寨峒，掩擊敗之。

translations.literal: The army halted at Batoushan; separate rebels besieged Zhaojiaping stockade cave; ambush-attacked and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: The army halted at Batoushan; other rebels were besieging Zhaojiaping cave stockade, and he ambushed and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 又殲黃號餘賊於太平邀仙崖，乘勝破八卦山，殪賊渠李顯林。

translations.literal: Again exterminated Yellow Banner remnant rebels at Yaoxian Cliff in Taiping; seized victory to break Bagua Mountain; killed rebel chief Li Xianlin.
translations.idiomatic: He next wiped out Yellow Banner survivors at Yaoxian Cliff in Taiping, followed up by storming Bagua Mountain and killing the rebel chief Li Xianlin.

sentences.zh: 七年，搜剿老林，連敗苟文明於雙河口、圓嶺山，擒其黨姚青雲。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, searched and suppressed the old forest; repeatedly defeated Gou Wenming at Shuanghekou and Yuanling Mountain; captured his follower Yao Qingyun.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he scoured the old forest, repeatedly defeated Gou Wenming at Shuanghekou and Yuanling Mountain, and captured his follower Yao Qingyun.

sentences.zh: 額勒登保檄回剿川賊，大烈乞病，解職回籍。

translations.literal: E'erdengbao ordered return to suppress Sichuan rebels; Dalie begged illness; resigned office and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: When E'erdengbao ordered him back to suppress Sichuan rebels, Xue Dalie pleaded illness, resigned, and returned home.

sentences.zh: 九年，病痊，命在乾清門行走。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, illness cured; ordered to serve at the Qianqing Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, recovered, he was ordered to serve at the Qianqing Gate.

sentences.zh: 扈從墜馬，遣蒙古醫療治，給頭等侍衛歲俸。

translations.literal: While escorting, fell from horse; sent a Mongol physician to treat; granted first-class bodyguard annual salary.
translations.idiomatic: While escorting the emperor he fell from his horse; a Mongol physician was sent to treat him, and he was granted the annual stipend of a first-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 尋授天津鎮總兵，擢直隸提督，賞黃馬褂。

translations.literal: Soon appointed Tianjin garrison commander; promoted to Zhili governor-general; granted yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was made commander of the Tianjin garrison, promoted to governor-general of Zhili, and granted a yellow riding jacket.

sentences.zh: 十一年，從德楞泰赴寧陝剿撫叛兵，調固原提督。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, followed Delengtai to Ningshan to suppress and pacify mutinous troops; transferred to Guyuan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he followed Delengtai to Ningshan to suppress and pacify mutinous troops and was transferred to governor-general of Guyuan.

sentences.zh: 明年，偕楊遇春平瓦石坪之亂，予優敘。

translations.literal: The next year, with Yang Yuchun pacified the Wanshiping turmoil; granted exceptional commendation.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, with Yang Yuchun, he pacified the Wanshiping uprising and received exceptional commendation.

sentences.zh: 調江南，復調直隸。

translations.literal: Transferred to Jiangnan; again transferred to Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Jiangnan and then back to Zhili.

sentences.zh: 坐為子娶所屬守備女，降天津鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Impeached for having his son marry a subordinate garrison commandant's daughter; demoted to Tianjin garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: He was censured for having his son marry the daughter of a garrison commandant under his command and was demoted to commander of the Tianjin garrison.

sentences.zh: 尋授廣東提督。

translations.literal: Soon appointed Guangdong governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was appointed governor-general of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 复坐動用馬乾銀，再降漢中鎮總兵，調河北鎮。

translations.literal: Again impeached for using horse-fodder silver; again demoted to Hanzhong garrison commander; transferred to Hebei garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Again censured for misusing horse-fodder funds, he was demoted to commander of the Hanzhong garrison and transferred to the Hebei garrison.

sentences.zh: 二十年，以睢工出力，加提督銜。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, for contribution on the Sui River works, added governor-general rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, for his work on the Sui River project, he was granted the rank of governor-general.

sentences.zh: 卒於官，錄前勞，依提督例賜卹，諡襄恪。

translations.literal: Died in office; recorded former labors; according to governor-general precedent granted mourning honors; posthumous name Xiangke.
translations.idiomatic: He died in office; his earlier service was recorded, he was granted posthumous honors by governor-general precedent, and was given the posthumous name Xiangke.

sentences.zh: 羅聲皋，四川雙流人。

translations.literal: Luo Shenggao, a native of Shuangliu, Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Shenggao was a native of Shuangliu in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 由行伍授把總。

translations.literal: From the ranks appointed platoon leader.
translations.idiomatic: From the ranks he was made a platoon leader.

sentences.zh: 從孫士毅赴湖北剿匪，克旗鼓寨、芭葉山，擢守備。

translations.literal: Followed Sun Shiyi to Hubei to suppress bandits; captured Qibo Stockade and Baye Mountain; promoted to garrison commandant.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Sun Shiyi to Hubei to suppress rebels, took Qibo Stockade and Baye Mountain, and was promoted to garrison commandant.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶三年，勒保調回四川。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jiaqing, Lebao recalled him to Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jiaqing, Lebao transferred him back to Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 四年，從額勒登保破徐天德、冷天祿，累擢游擊。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, following E'erdengbao broke Xu Tiande and Leng Tianlu; repeatedly promoted to battalion commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he followed E'erdengbao in defeating Xu Tiande and Leng Tianlu and rose by stages to battalion commander.

sentences.zh: 五年，授提標中軍參將。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, appointed colonel of the commander's central battalion.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was made colonel of the commander's central battalion.

sentences.zh: 破冉天士於南江長池壩，賜花翎。

translations.literal: Broke Ran Tianshi at Changchiba in Nanjiang; granted peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: He defeated Ran Tianshi at Changchiba in Nanjiang and was granted a peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 六年，偕薛大烈殲曹世倫，追湯思蛟、劉朝選入楚，敗之於竹山柳林店。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, with Xue Dalie destroyed Cao Shilun; pursued Tang Sijiao and Liu Chaoxuan into Huguang; defeated them at Liulindian in Zhushan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, with Xue Dalie, he destroyed Cao Shilun and pursued Tang Sijiao and Liu Chaoxuan into Huguang, defeating them at Liulindian in Zhushan.

sentences.zh: 青、藍號賊擾東鄉，偕大烈敗之，又偕擊賊石鐍山，徐天壽就擒，賜號濟特庫勒特依巴圖魯。

translations.literal: Green and Blue Banner rebels harassed Dongxiang; with Dalie defeated them; again jointly attacked rebels at Shijueshan; Xu Tianshou captured; granted the title Jitekuleteyi Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: Green and Blue Banner rebels raided Dongxiang; with Xue Dalie he defeated them, and together they struck rebels at Shijueshan, where Xu Tianshou was captured; Luo Shenggao was granted the title Jitekuleteyi Batulu.

sentences.zh: 遂合擊高見奇，擒冉學勝。

translations.literal: Then jointly attacked Gao Jianqi; captured Ran Xuesheng.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined in the attack on Gao Jianqi and captured Ran Xuesheng.

sentences.zh: 冬，偕張績擒蕭焜於太平。

translations.literal: In winter, with Zhang Ji captured Xiao Kun at Taiping.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, with Zhang Ji, he captured Xiao Kun in Taiping.

sentences.zh: 黃號餘賊屯茨竹溝，聲皋自花角園進攻，大軍繼之，擒葛士寬等。

translations.literal: Yellow-Banner remnant rebels encamped at Cizhugou; Shenggao attacked from Huajiaoyuan, the main army followed, and Ge Shikuan and others were captured.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow-Banner remnant rebels held Cizhugou; Shenggao attacked from Huajiaoyuan, the main force followed up, and Ge Shikuan and others were taken prisoner.

sentences.zh: 七年，遷督標中軍副將，充翼長。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was transferred to deputy commander of the provincial commander's central army and served as wing commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he became deputy commander of the provincial commander's central army and served as a wing commander.

sentences.zh: 張簡與湯思蛟合擾東鄉，敗之於老生園、楊家壩，偕田朝貴兵合擊，蹙之河濱，賊爭赴水，擒思蛟弟思武，追擒汪貴於太平梧桐坪。

translations.literal: Zhang Jian and Tang Sijiao together harassed Dongxiang; he defeated them at Laoshengyuan and Yangjiaba, joined Tian Chaogui's troops in a combined attack, drove them to the riverbank where rebels rushed into the water, captured Sijiao's younger brother Siwu, and pursued and captured Wang Gui at Wutongping in Taiping.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jian and Tang Sijiao joined forces to raid Dongxiang; he routed them at Laoshengyuan and Yangjiaba, combined with Tian Chaogui's troops to corner them on the riverbank, where many rebels drowned themselves rushing into the water; he captured Sijiao's brother Siwu and ran down Wang Gui at Wutongping in Taiping.

sentences.zh: 庹向瑤竄東鄉鳳皇山，偕達思呼勒岱合圍，殲其眾，擒向瑤。

translations.literal: Tuo Xiangyao fled to Fenghuang Mountain in Dongxiang; with Dasihuledai he encircled them, destroyed their force, and captured Xiangyao.
translations.idiomatic: Tuo Xiangyao fled to Fenghuang Mountain in Dongxiang; with Dasihuledai he surrounded the band, wiped out their force, and captured Xiangyao.

sentences.zh: 川匪漸清。

translations.literal: Rebel activity in Sichuan gradually cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel activity in Sichuan was gradually brought under control.

sentences.zh: 楚匪被剿急，多竄川境。

translations.literal: Huguang rebels, hard pressed in suppression, mostly fled into Sichuan territory.
translations.idiomatic: Hard pressed in Huguang, many rebels fled into Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 偕達思呼勒岱合擊，殲賴飛龍於雲陽閻王碥；

translations.literal: With Dasihuledai he attacked jointly and destroyed Lai Feilong at Yanwangbian in Yunyang;
translations.idiomatic: With Dasihuledai he joined in an attack that destroyed Lai Feilong at Yanwangbian in Yunyang;

sentences.zh: 又偕羅思舉追賊巴州，分兩路遁，思舉擒簡，聲皋獲思蛟於東鄉村店。

translations.literal: again with Luo Siju he pursued rebels to Bazhou; they fled in two directions; Siju captured Jian, and Shenggao took Sijiao at Dongxiang Cundian.
translations.idiomatic: and with Luo Siju he pursued the rebels to Bazhou; they split and fled on two routes; Siju captured Jian, and Shenggao took Sijiao at Dongxiang Cundian.

sentences.zh: 八年，搜剿餘匪，擒青號張朝隴、李明學。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he searched out remnant bandits and captured Green-Banner Zhang Chaolong and Li Mingxue.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he hunted down remnant rebels and captured Green-Banner Zhang Chaolong and Li Mingxue.

sentences.zh: 軍事大定，赴達州辦理凱撤兵勇事宜。

translations.literal: When the military situation was largely settled, he went to Dazhou to handle matters of demobilizing victorious troops.
translations.idiomatic: When the campaign was largely concluded, he went to Dazhou to oversee the demobilization of victorious troops.

sentences.zh: 十三年，從勒保剿馬邊涼山彝匪，克曲曲烏彝寨，擢重慶鎮總兵，調松潘鎮。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he followed Lebao in suppressing Yi bandits at Mabian and Liangshan, captured Ququwu Yi Stockade, was promoted to general at Chongqing, and transferred to Songpan.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he followed Lebao against Yi rebels at Mabian and Liangshan, captured Ququwu Stockade, was promoted to Chongqing general, and transferred to Songpan.

sentences.zh: 二十年，剿中瞻對叛番，克滄龍溝。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he suppressed rebellious Tibetans in Zhongzandui and captured Canglong Gully.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he campaigned against rebellious Tibetans in Zhongzandui and took Canglong Gully.

sentences.zh: 番酋洛布七力守險，未大創，乞降，受之，以專擅褫職，戍伊犁。

translations.literal: The Tibetan chief Luobuqili held strong ground and was not severely wounded; he begged to surrender and was accepted; for acting on his own authority Shenggao was stripped of office and exiled to Ili.
translations.idiomatic: The Tibetan chief Luobuqili held the high ground and was not broken; he begged to surrender and Shenggao accepted; for acting on his own authority he was stripped of office and exiled to Ili.

sentences.zh: 逾三年赦歸，卒於家。

translations.literal: After more than three years he was pardoned and returned home, and died there.
translations.idiomatic: After more than three years he was pardoned and returned home, where he died.

sentences.zh: 薛升，貴州畢節人。

translations.literal: Xue Sheng was a native of Bijie in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Sheng was from Bijie in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 以鄉勇剿仲苗，授把總。

translations.literal: As a local militiaman he suppressed the Zhong Miao and was appointed platoon commander.
translations.idiomatic: As a local militiaman he helped suppress the Zhong Miao and was appointed platoon commander.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶三年，從勒保赴四川軍，偕羅思舉攻安樂坪，攀援絕壁入賊營，斬馘多，進攻祖師觀，夜伏手把岩下，拔柵而登，又從薛大烈設伏，破撲營賊，常為軍鋒，擢守備。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jiaqing he followed Lebao to the Sichuan army, joined Luo Siju in attacking Anleping, climbed sheer cliffs into the rebel camp and killed many, advanced on Zushiguan, lay in ambush by night below Shouba Rock, pulled down palisades and mounted, again followed Xue Dalie's ambush to break rebels assaulting the camp, often served as army vanguard, and was promoted to garrison commandant.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jiaqing he followed Lebao into Sichuan, joined Luo Siju at Anleping, scaled sheer cliffs into the rebel camp and killed many, advanced on Zushiguan, lay in ambush by night below Shouba Rock, tore down palisades and climbed in, and again joined Xue Dalie's ambush to break a camp assault; he often led the van and was promoted to garrison commandant.

sentences.zh: 四年，殲龔文玉、包正洪，升皆從戰有功，賜花翎。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he destroyed Gong Wenyu and Bao Zhenghong; Sheng fought with merit throughout and was granted a peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he helped destroy Gong Wenyu and Bao Zhenghong; Sheng distinguished himself in every action and received a peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 五年，兜剿川東竄匪，升率兵分駐黃草壩，尋擊賊八石坪，追至東鄉南壩場，敗之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, in rounding up fleeing rebels in eastern Sichuan, Sheng led troops posted separately at Huangcaoba, soon struck rebels at Bashiping, pursued to Nanbachang in Dongxiang, and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, while rounding up fleeing rebels in eastern Sichuan, Sheng posted troops at Huangcaoba, struck the enemy at Bashiping, pursued them to Nanbachang in Dongxiang, and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 軍駐蘆花嶺，賊夜撲營，先伏兵山洞伺擊，賊大潰，擢都司。

translations.literal: The army camped at Luhualing; rebels assaulted the camp by night; he first hid troops in a mountain cave to strike them, the rebels broke in great rout, and he was promoted to battalion commander.
