translations.idiomatic: While the army was at Luhualing the rebels attacked by night; he had troops waiting in a cave and struck them as they came, putting them to rout, and was promoted to battalion commander.

sentences.zh: 偕桂涵破猴兒岩賊巢，擒唐大魁。

translations.literal: With Gui Han he broke the rebel nest at Hou'eryan and captured Tang Dakui.
translations.idiomatic: With Gui Han he overran the rebel nest at Hou'eryan and captured Tang Dakui.

sentences.zh: 六年，從薛大烈擊賊巴州石鐍山，分路要截，多有斬獲，擒徐天壽於王家坪，擢游擊。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he followed Xue Dalie against rebels at Shijueshan in Bazhou, blocked them on separate routes with many kills and captures, captured Xu Tianshou at Wangjiaping, and was promoted to colonel.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he followed Xue Dalie at Shijueshan in Bazhou, cut the enemy off on separate routes with heavy losses inflicted, captured Xu Tianshou at Wangjiaping, and was promoted to colonel.

sentences.zh: 七年，從勒保殲張天倫，遂從田朝貴防川、陝邊界，擒徐天培於徐羅壩，殲楊呂清於白岩峒。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he followed Lebao in destroying Zhang Tianlun, then with Tian Chaogui guarded the Sichuan-Shaanxi border, captured Xu Tianpei at Xuluoba, and destroyed Yang Luqing at Baiyandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he followed Lebao in destroying Zhang Tianlun, then with Tian Chaogui guarded the Sichuan-Shaanxi frontier, captured Xu Tianpei at Xuluoba, and wiped out Yang Luqing at Baiyandong.

sentences.zh: 八年，入山搜捕，擊走苟朝九股匪於八百谿，擢雲南新習營參將。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he entered the mountains to search and capture, drove off Gou Chao's nine bands at Babai Stream, and was promoted to brigade commander of the Yunnan New Training Camp.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he searched the mountains, drove off Gou Chao's nine bands at Babai Stream, and was promoted to brigade commander of the Yunnan New Training Camp.

sentences.zh: 軍事蕆，赴本官，歷東川、尋霑參將。

translations.literal: When the campaign concluded he went to his regular post and successively served as brigade commander at Dongchuan and Xunqian.
translations.idiomatic: When the campaign ended he took up his regular post and served in turn as brigade commander at Dongchuan and Xunqian.

sentences.zh: 十八年，調剿滑縣教匪，攻克南門，擢副將，尋回雲南。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was transferred to suppress sect rebels at Huaxian, stormed the south gate, was promoted to brigadier, and soon returned to Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he was sent to suppress the Huaxian sect rebels, stormed the south gate, was promoted to brigadier, and soon returned to Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，從剿臨安夷匪，授永昌協副將。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he joined the campaign against Yi bandits at Lin'an and was appointed deputy commander of the Yongchang garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he joined the campaign against Yi rebels at Lin'an and was appointed deputy commander of the Yongchang garrison.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，剿大姚夷匪，擢鶴麗鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daoguang he suppressed Yi bandits at Dayao and was promoted to general at Heli.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Daoguang he suppressed Yi rebels at Dayao and was promoted to general at Heli.

sentences.zh: 歷陝西河州鎮、直隸大名鎮，擢直隸提督，調湖南。

translations.literal: He successively served at Hezhou in Shaanxi and Daming in Zhili, was promoted to Zhili provincial commander, and transferred to Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn at Hezhou in Shaanxi and Daming in Zhili, was promoted to Zhili provincial commander, and was transferred to Hunan.

sentences.zh: 十六年，新寧瑤生藍正樽習教拒捕，犯武岡城，鎮筸兵滋事戕官，事皆旋定，吏議鐫級留任。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year the Yao native Lan Zhengzun of Xinning, having learned sect teachings, resisted arrest, attacked Wugang city, and Zhengan troops mutinied and killed an official; both affairs were soon settled, but the civil authorities proposed demotion by one grade while retaining him in office.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year the Yao native Lan Zhengzun of Xinning, indoctrinated in the sect teachings, resisted arrest and attacked Wugang; Zhengan troops also mutinied and killed an official. Both crises were soon settled, but the civil authorities recommended demoting him one grade while keeping him in post.

sentences.zh: 升年已七十，總督林則徐疏論其老於軍事而無振作。

translations.literal: Sheng was already seventy; Governor-General Lin Zexu memorialized that he was experienced in military affairs but lacked vigor.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng was already seventy; Governor-General Lin Zexu reported that while he was experienced in military affairs, he lacked vigor.

sentences.zh: 未幾，以楊芳代之，調升廣西提督。

translations.literal: Before long Yang Fang replaced him, and Sheng was transferred to provincial commander in Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Yang Fang replaced him, and Sheng was transferred to Guangxi as provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，英吉利犯廣東，赴潯梧治防。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, when England attacked Guangdong, he went to Xunwu to organize defenses.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, when Britain attacked Guangdong, he went to Xunwu to organize the defenses.

sentences.zh: 因病乞假歸，尋休致，以舊勞予食全俸。

translations.literal: On grounds of illness he asked leave to return home, soon retired, and was granted full salary in recognition of past service.
translations.idiomatic: He asked leave to return home on account of illness, retired soon afterward, and received full pay in recognition of his earlier service.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，卒，諡勤勇。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng he died and was given the posthumous name Qinyong.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xianfeng he died and received the posthumous name Qinyong.

sentences.zh: 論曰：額勒登保以楊遇春、穆克登佈為翼長，德楞泰以賽衝阿、馬瑜為翼長，勒保以薛大烈、羅聲皋為翼長，觀偏裨之人材，其成功可知矣。

translations.literal: The commentary says: Eledengbao took Yang Yuchun and Mukedengbu as wing commanders, Delengtai took Sai Chong'a and Ma Yu, Lebao took Xue Dalie and Luo Shenggao—judging from the talent of these subordinate officers, one can see why they succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: The commentators observe: Eledengbao had Yang Yuchun and Mukedengbu as his wing commanders, Delengtai had Sai Chong'a and Ma Yu, and Lebao had Xue Dalie and Luo Shenggao. Judging from the quality of these subordinate commanders, it is no surprise that they won their campaigns.

sentences.zh: 是諸人者，其後多膺軍寄，二楊而外，亦無赫赫功，豈非材器有所限哉？

translations.literal: These men afterward mostly received important military appointments, yet apart from the two Yangs none achieved resounding fame—was this not because their talent and capacity had limits?
translations.idiomatic: Most of these men later received important military appointments, yet apart from the two Yangs none won resounding fame afterward. Was this not because their talent and capacity had natural limits?

sentences.zh: 勒保部將差弱，蓋賴羅思舉、桂涵等鄉勇之力為多焉。

translations.literal: Lebao's subordinate generals were rather weak; he relied for the most part on the strength of local militia leaders such as Luo Siju and Gui Han.
translations.idiomatic: Lebao's own subordinate commanders were comparatively weak; he owed most of his success to local militia leaders such as Luo Siju and Gui Han.
